_source: Move Basic descriptions — owned, hand-maintained data (originally sourced from serebii.net/pokemonunite; the scraper has been retired). normalize.py backfills blank UNITE-DB descriptions from here, keyed by pokemon id -> normalized move name (lowercase; trailing parenthetical/apostrophes stripped) -> Basic-tier text.

alcremie.helping hand: Has the user grant a designated ally Pokémon a shield and increase that Pokémon's Attack and Sp. Atk for a short time.
alcremie.decorate:
Has the user grant a designated ally Pokémon a shield. Each time the shielded ally Pokémon attacks with a basic attack, it deals additional damage. When the user's sweet gauge becomes full, the additional damage this move grants the shielded ally Pokémon is even greater. When used on an ally, the user also gains a shield that does not deal additional damage.

Upgrade (Level 10): Increases the strength of the shield.
alcremie.recover:
Has the user place a dollop of whipped cream at the designated location. The dollop stays at that location for a short time. When an ally Pokémon picks up the dollop, their HP is restored, their movement speed increases and the user's sweet gauge increases. When the user's sweet gauge is full, the next dollop becomes sweeter, restoring more HP and increasing movement speed even more.

Upgrade (Level 10): The maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve is increased to 3.
alcremie.charm: Has the user send its cute voice in the designated direction, applying a slowing effect on opposing Pokémon it hits, decreasing their Attack and Sp. Atk and increasing the user's sweet gauge.
alcremie.dazzling gleam:
Has the user release a ray of light in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits, leaving them unable to act, and increasing the user's sweet gauge. If an ally Pokémon has a shield granted by Decorate, that Pokémon releases a ray of light as well.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases the damage of this move.
alcremie.sweet scent:
Has the user launch a sweet scent at a designated location, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. A circle of scent remains for a short time, dealing damage, applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon that touch it, and increasing the user's sweet gauge.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases the duration of the outer ring slow to 1.5s.
alcremie.fluffy cream supreme: Has the user create a giant cake and stand on it, granting the user a shield. The user then sends whipped cream to nearby ally Pokémon. Ally Pokémon who receive whipped cream have their HP restored and their max HP increased for a short time. The Unite Move ends when the user loses its shield.
alcremie.aroma veil: When an ally is under the effect of one of Alcremie's shields or buffs, remove any hindrances that are applied or are currently affecting that ally. This ability will go on cooldown for 10s after removing a hindrance. This ability can also work on Alcremie as well.

armarouge.basic attack: Every time the user hits an opposing Pokemon with a basic attack, its cannon gauge increases. When the cannon gauge is full, the user's next basic attack consumes the entire gauge and becomes a boosted attack. When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, a blazing mark is applied to it. Ceruledge
armarouge.incinerate: Has the user attack the designated opposing Pokémon with a flame, setting it ablaze and dealing damage over time for a short time. When a Pokémon on the opposing team that's ablaze picks up a berry, the berry's effects are halved.
armarouge.fire spin:
Has the user generate a fierce vortex of fire around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and increasing the user's movement speed. When the user is moving toward Pokémon on the opposing team, its movement speed is further increased. Whenever the user deals damage, it receives a shield effect. This effect can stack up to 6 times.If the user hits opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, the duration of the vortex is increased.

Upgrade (Level 11): Upon using Fire Spin+, gain 3 stacks of shields.
armarouge.armor cannon:
Has the user combine its shoulder armor and charge power, then fire a blazing ball of flame. The user releases a shock wave in front of itself when firing, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. The fired ball of flame explodes when it hits an opposing Pokémon or after it travels a set distance, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and leaving them unable to act. The user's Def and Sp. Def are decreased for a short time after using this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the range of this move and auto attacks.
armarouge.will-o-wisp: Has the user shoot a flame in the designated direction, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them burned for a short time. After using this move, the user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
armarouge.flame charge:
Has the user cloak itself in flame and charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and shoving them. When this move hits an opposing Pokémon, the user is granted a shield and this move's cooldown is reduced. For a short time after using this move, the cannon gauge becomes full and will not decrease after boosted attacks are used.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces the damage the user receives by 20% for 3s after this move hits an opposing Pokémon.
armarouge.psyshock:
Has the user materialize odd psychic waves to attack in three areas of effect in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits while partially ignoring their Sp. Def and applying a slowing effect. The 3rd attack throws opposing Pokémon it hits. For a short time after using this move, the cannon gauge becomes full and will not decrease after boosted attacks are used.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases this move's area of effect for the third area blast.
armarouge.psykaboom: Has the user jump up and charge psychic power, then create an area that leaves opposing Pokémon unable to move. While the user is charging psychic power, the position of the area can be adjusted. The user then fires a ball of flame toward the center of the area, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them outside of the area.
armarouge.attack - charcadet: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
armarouge.flash fire: When this Pokémon takes Sp. Atk-based damage from opposing Pokémon, the damage this Pokémon takes is reduced by 20% for 3s, and their next auto attack deals additional damage. This Ability goes on a 10s cooldown after it ends.

articuno.basic attack: Has the user hurl ice, applying a slowing effect and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon.
articuno.icy wind: Has the user blast a gust of chilled air in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and causing snow to fall, freezing the ground for a short time.
articuno.blizzard:
Has the user summon a howling blizzard centered on itself, applying a freeze counter and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. If an opposing Pokémon’s freeze counter reaches 5, that Pokémon becomes frozen.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the amount of hits to 8.
articuno.ice shard: Has the user hurl a chunk of ice in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon that has a freeze counter, that Pokémon becomes instantly frozen. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon that is frozen, the ice shatters to deal additional damage.
articuno.ice beam:
Has the user shoot out a beam of icy-cold energy in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon that has a freeze counter, that Pokémon becomes frozen. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon that is frozen, the ice shatters to deal additional damage.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the freeze duration to 2s when opponents are frozen by the move.
articuno.ice wing whiteout: Increases the duration this move leaves opposing Pokémon frozen.
articuno.snow cloak: After Ice Shard or Ice Beam is used, the user gains 10% damage resistance for 4s; after Icy Wind, Blizzard, or Unite Move is used the user gains 20% damage resistance for 5s. If move 1 or Unite Move is used after move 2 activated the ability, then the effect is dynamically upgraded to the improved version. Afterwards the ability goes on cooldown for 10s.

blaziken.basic attack: Deals damage to nearby opposing Pokémon. If the user is in kick style, its basic attacks' area of effect is increased. If the user is in punch style, its basic attack speed is increased.
blaziken.aerial ace: Has the user dash in the designated direction, slashing in front of itself and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with this move, for a short time, this move can be used again once only.
blaziken.fire punch:
Has the user unleash a flaming punch in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.The designated direction can be changed during the move.When the user hits an opposing Pokémon with this move, for a short time, this move can be used again once only.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases damage dealt.
blaziken.blaze kick:
Has the user unleash a kick while leaping toward the designated location, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and shoving them. The shoved opposing Pokémon will have their movement speed decreased for a short time.If the shoved opposing Pokémon come in contact with a wall, they will be left unable to act instead of having their movement speed decreased.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the movement speed decrease to 50%. Increases the stun duration to 1.5s if hitting a wall.
blaziken.overheat:
Has the user start charging power in place. If this move is used again after the user has started charging, the user unleashes a flaming kick in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.The longer power is charged, the more damage this move deals. If the user charges a set amount of power or more, this move also shoves opposing Pokémon it hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases damage dealt.
blaziken.ember: Has the user release a small ball of fire in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed.
blaziken.focus blast:
Has the user fire a ball of focused energy in the designated direction.The ball of focused energy explodes upon hitting an opposing Pokémon or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the explosion's area of effect and decreasing their movement speed.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the movement speed decrease to 60%.
blaziken.spinning flame fist: Has the user do a flaming punch around itself, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon it hits and increasing the user's movement speed for a short time. After using this move, the user switches to fist style.
blaziken.spinning flame kick: Has the user do a flaming kick around itself, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon it hits and increasing the user's Attack for a short time. After using this move, the user switches to kick style.
blaziken.blaze: When this Pokémon hits an enemy with an auto attack or move, that enemy receives a fire fragment for 4s and the duration of all other fire fragments on that enemy are refreshed. When an enemy has 5 fire fragments, all 5 are consumed to deal additional damage to the enemy and restore the user's HP. When this Pokémon's HP is at half or lower, more HP is restored.

buzzwole.basic attack: Each time a basic attack hits an opposing Pokémon, the muscle gauge charges by 1 increment. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, throwing two consecutive punches while restoring the user's HP.
buzzwole.mega punch: Has the user move in the designated direction before slamming the ground with a powerful punch. The shock from the punch deals damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. If this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the user's muscle gauge increases by 1 increment for each one that was hit.
buzzwole.lunge:
Has the user lunge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and decreasing their Attack for a short time. If this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the user's muscle gauge increases by 1 increment for each one that was hit. After this move is used, the user's basic attack speed increases for a short time. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 13): Whenever this move hits enemy players, Buzzwole's Attack increases by 10% for 2s for each player hit (up to a max of 5 stacks).
buzzwole.smack down:
Has the user deliver an uppercut punch to an opposing Pokémon in the designated direction, dealing damage to it and throwing it into the air. While the thrown Pokémon is airborne, the user can use this move again to perform a follow-up attack that smacks that Pokémon down to the ground, dealing damage to all opposing Pokémon in an area of effect centered on the smacked-down Pokémon. If the user does not follow up on the initial uppercut attack, the opposing Pokémon will fall to the ground on its own. If this occurs, damage is still dealt to all opposing Pokémon in an area of effect centered on the point of impact. If this move deals damage to Pokémon on the opposing team, the user's muscle gauge increases by 1 increment for each one that was hit.

Upgrade (Level 13): Widens the area-of-effect in which damage is dealt when the grappled enemy slams the ground. Additionally, muscle gauge will now increase by 2 increments for each enemy player hit from the slam.
buzzwole.fell stinger: Consumes the entire muscle gauge and has the user deal damage to an opposing Pokémon in the designated direction. This move deals more damage the more muscle gauge increments are consumed. If this move knocks out an opposing Pokémon, the user recovers HP.
buzzwole.leech life:
Has the user grab and restrain an opposing Pokémon in the designated direction, dealing damage over time while restoring the user's HP. When this move is used, it consumes the user's entire muscle gauge. The number of hits and the amount of damage dealt per hit increases the more muscle gauge increments are consumed. This move ends if the user becomes unable to act for any reason or if the restrained Pokémon escapes by using an Eject Button or through some other means.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also causes each instance of damage dealt by this move to be stronger than the last by 5% additively.
buzzwole.superpower:
Consumes the entire muscle gauge and has the user run in the designated direction and grab an opposing Pokémon. The user then slams the opposing Pokémon down on the ground at full strength, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. The damage dealt by this move and the shield effect it grants increases the more muscle gauge increments are consumed.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces the cooldown of this move by 3s when the user's muscle gauge reaches maximum.
buzzwole.ultra swole slam: Has the user fly at high speed, dealing damage to all opposing Pokémon in the area of effect. Afterward, the user targets the opposing Pokémon with the lowest percentage of HP among those hit and charges down at it from the sky, dealing damage once again to that Pokémon.
buzzwole.beast boost: When Buzzwole knocks out an enemy player, movement speed is increased by 100% and basic attack speed increased by 50% for 3s. When Buzzwole assists in knocking out an enemy player, movement speed is increased by 50% and basic attack speed increased by 25% for 3s. Each time Buzzwole hits an enemy with basic attacks, Mega Punch, Lunge, or Smack Down - muscle gauge increases. Conversely, when Buzzwole has been out of combat for 10s, muscle gauge depletes by 1 increment every 5s. Up to 6 muscle gauge increments can be stored.

ceruledge.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack every 4 attacks, dealing damage twice. The next basic attack after using a move becomes a boosted attack Ceruledge
ceruledge.lava plume: Has the user torch the area around itself with an inferno of scarlet flames, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. The user's next basic attack on opposing Pokémon hit by this move deals increased damage.
ceruledge.bitter blade:
Has the user focus its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user recovers HP based on the amount of damage this move deals. Any HP recovered that exceeds the user's max HP is converted into a shield.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the amount of HP recovered to 70% of damage dealt.
ceruledge.psycho cut:
Has the user launch a blade formed by psychic power in the designated direction, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move have their Defense decreased for a short time. If the user hits opposing Pokémon with a basic attack, this move's cooldown is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the Defense reduction of enemies hit by this move.
ceruledge.take down: Has the user charge recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. The user's basic attack speed is increased for a short time.
ceruledge.phantom force:
Has the user dash and disappear into darkness, where it hides for a short time. While it is hiding, it cannot move. When this move is used again, the user appears in the designated direction while slashing around itself, dealing damage that ignores Defense and shields to opposing Pokémon it hits and applying a slowing effect to them. If this move hits opposing Pokémon, its cooldown is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.
ceruledge.flame charge:
Has the user cloak itself in flame and charge in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. The user's basic attack speed is increased for a short time after using this move. A maximum of 2 use(s) can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 13): Ceruledge's basic attack speed is instead increased for 5s after using this move.
ceruledge.revenant rend: Has the user ready both of its arm blades before slashing through to the designated location faster than the eye can track. The user leaves opposing Pokémon it hits unable to act before striking them with three slashing blows.
ceruledge.attack - charcadet: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
ceruledge.flame body: When Charcadet hits an enemy with an auto attack, Charcadet deals damage around themself with flames. This ability goes on a 4s cd after it's triggered.

chandelure.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack whenever a set amount of time passes, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits, decreasing their movement speed, and leaving them burned.
chandelure.ember: Has the user shoot out a small flame, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits, decreasing their movement speed, and leaving them burned. For a short time after this move is used, it can be used again.
chandelure.flamethrower:
Has the user shoot an intense blast of fire in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them burned. The end of the blast explodes, dealing increased damage. If this explosion hits an opposing Pokémon, this move's cooldown is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 11): If the explosion hits a Pokémon, Chandelure deals 20% increased damage for 3s. This effect also applies to the triggering explosion itself.
chandelure.overheat:
Has the user throw consecutive flames in an arc into the designated area up to 3 times, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon they hit and leaving them burned. When a flame hits an opposing Pokémon, the user gains one heat energy. If this move is used again, the user shoots out an exploding flame, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits based on the user's amount of heat energy and leaving them burned. After using the follow-up attack, the user cannot use basic attacks for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): This move's cooldown is reduced by 1s.
chandelure.night shade: Makes opposing Pokémon in the area of effect see a frightening mirage, dealing damage to them and marking them. When the user deals damage again to marked opposing Pokémon, those Pokémon are left unable to act for a short time.
chandelure.poltergeist:
Has the user create a zone of mysterious power, as well as mirages of floating furniture-such as tables and chairs-inside it. Any opposing Pokémon that comes in contact with a mirage takes damage and has its movement speed decreased. Opposing Pokémon that step on the zone's border will also have their movement speed decreased.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the slow to 80% for 1s decaying to 50% for 1s.
chandelure.imprison:
Has the user create a zone in front of itself. The first opposing Pokémon caught in it will become unable to move, and all opposing Pokémon in or that enter the zone become imprisoned and cannot use moves.

Upgrade (Level 13): Changes the Imprison to briefly immobilize all Pokémon caught in the zone on creation.
chandelure.ignite midnight: The user seals the area around itself in darkness and obscures opposing Pokémon's vision for a short time. If this Unite Move is used again, the user continuously fires a beam of fire in a designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. The beam can be directed while fired, and its final blast deals increased damage.
chandelure.infiltrator: When this Pokémon deals damage, receive a stacking buff that makes Special damage dealt by this Pokémon ignore 5% of Special Defense per stack. This buff lasts 4s, can stack up to 6 times, and the duration refreshes when gaining a new stack.

charizard.basic attack: Inflicts continuous damage. After evolving, the distance of the basic attack increases. If the opponent is burned the damage inflicted is increased
charizard.flame burst: Attack with a bursting flame. When this move hits, it leaves enemies burned and increases the user's movement speed for a short time.
charizard.flamethrower:
Attack with an intense blast of fire. When this move hits, it leaves enemies burned and increases the user's movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage and the damage caused by burning.
charizard.fire punch:
Punch with a fiery fist, dealing damage and shoving enemies when it hits. Also leaves the enemies it shoves burned.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduced cooldown every time a basic attack hits.
charizard.fire spin: Encircles enemies in the area of effect in a vortex of fire. After this move hits, it deals damage over time and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.
charizard.fire blast:
Blasts intense, all-consuming fire, dealing damage over time to enemies while the flames continue to burn on the ground and decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
charizard.flare blitz:
Charge forward cloaked in fire, granting the user a shield and throwing enemies hit.

Upgrade (Level 13): Decreases movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are thrown.
charizard.seismic slam: Fly up into the air, allowing the user to move freely over obstacles. While this move is being used, basic attacks deal increased damage and leave enemies burned. In addition, when dealing damage to an enemy, recover HP. Using this move again on an enemy will grab it and slam it onto the ground.
charizard.blaze: While at half HP or less, critical-hit rate is increased.

clefable.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage
clefable.heal pulse: Has the user immediately restore HP to itself and nearby allies.
clefable.moonlight:
Clefable continually restores HP to themself and nearby allies for a short time. Clefable's movement speed is increased while this move is active.

Upgrade (Level 10): Widens this move's area-of-effect and increases the duration of its effects.
clefable.draining kiss:
Clefable attacks nearby enemies with an energy-draining kiss. Each enemy hit by the kiss receives damage and releases an air kiss. These air kisses will travel to a nearby ally with the lowest HP and restore their HP. If no allies are nearby, the air kisses will return to the user and restore Clefable's HP instead.

Upgrade (Level 10): Widens this move’s area-of-effect and increases the amount of HP restored to 200% of the damage dealt.
clefable.disarming voice: Has the user let out a charming cry, dealing damage to nearby enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
clefable.gravity:
Has the user create a gravity zone centered on itself that persists for a set amount of time. Inside the gravity zone, Clefable's auto attacks change and deal increased damage. Enemies in the zone have their movement speed decreased which becomes stronger whenever a set amount of time passes. These enemies are also unable to use dash moves. If an enemy attempts to enter the zone with a dash move, the dash move is stopped and that enemy is left unable to act for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 12): Widens the area-of-effect and increases the duration of its effects.
clefable.follow me:
Has the user move to the designated location while waving its finger, drawing the attention of opposing Pokémon it touches and opposing Pokémon near the designated location. Affected opposing Pokémon are forced to approach the user for a short time and attack it with their basic attacks.When this move is used, the user receives a shield effect.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases Clefable's Defense by 150 for 3s and Sp. Def by 100 for 3s when this move is used.
clefable.wonder wish: Has the user waggle its finger, restoring HP to ally Pokémon in the area of effect. The lower an ally Pokémon's HP is, the more HP this move restores to that ally.Afterward, the user gets a random move that it can perform by using its Unite Move again within a set amount of time. Note: Some random moves will activate immediately.
clefable.magic guard: This Pokémon receives a shield when restoring an ally Pokémon's HP. The strength of this shield is proportional to the amount of HP restored.

comfey.basic attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage and giving the user two flowers.
comfey.synthesis: When the user is not attached to an ally Pokémon, it attaches itself to the designated ally Pokémon and grants it a shield. When the user is attached to an ally Pokémon, it restores that ally Pokémon's HP. The more flowers that are consumed, the more HP that is restored. If the user releases, it will stop being attached and move in the designated direction.
comfey.floral healing:
When the user is not attached to an ally Pokémon, it attaches itself to the designated ally Pokémon and grants it a shield. When the user is attached to an ally Pokémon, it restores that ally Pokémon's HP. The more flowers that are consumed, the more HP that is restored. Any HP restored in excess of the ally Pokémon's maximum is converted into a shield. If the user releases, it will stop being attached and move in the designated direction.

Upgrade (Level 10): While attached: increases the movement speed of the ally Pokémon by 30% for 2s.
comfey.sweet kiss:
When the user is not attached to an ally Pokémon, it attaches itself to the designated ally Pokémon and grants it a shield. When the user is attached to an ally Pokémon, it charges power before making opposing Pokémon in the area of effect infatuated. Infatuated Pokémon approach the user against their will. The longer power is charged, the larger the area of effect; and the more flowers that are consumed, the longer Pokémon are infatuated. If the user releases, it will stop being attached and move in the designated direction.

Upgrade (Level 10): While attached: increases the movement speed of the ally Pokémon by 50% for 2s while charging power.
comfey.vine whip: Has the user strike out with whiplike vines in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
comfey.magical leaf:
Has the user launch three curious, scattering leaves each second for a set amount of time. The leaves target opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and deal damage when they hit. These leaves can even deal damage to opposing Pokémon hiding in tall grass. If the same opposing Pokémon is damaged six times by these leaves, that Pokémon will be left unable to act. If this move is used when the user is attached to an ally Pokémon, its area of effect is increased.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases the number of leaves launched to 4 leaves every 1s (maximum 24 leaves).
comfey.grass knot:
Has the user unleash vines in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them unable to move. This move can hit up to two opposing Pokémon. If it hits two opposing Pokémon, it pulls the second to the first's location and deals additional damage to both.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases this move’s area of effect.
comfey.flowery fields forever: Has the user create a large area of tall grass around itself. Pokémon in this tall grass cannot be seen, just as with other tall grass on the map. If ally Pokémon enter this tall grass, they will continually recover HP as long as they're in it. The user gains special flowers from this tall grass. Consuming these special flowers boosts Floral Healing and Sweet Kiss.
comfey.triage: Increases movement speed by 25% when near ally Pokémon at 50% max HP or below. Stores up to 8 flowers; consumes all flowers when using Synthesis, Floral Healing, or Sweet Kiss while attached, boosting their effects. Gains 1 flower every 1.5s. Gains 4 flowers when entering tall grass while detached (5s CD). Attaches to a designated ally Pokémon when using Synthesis, Floral Healing, or Sweet Kiss while detached, granting a Triage shield effect to the ally based on Comfey's max HP.

darkrai.basic attack: Basic attacks made against sleeping opposing Pokémon will become boosted attacks with increased range. Boosted attacks deal damage to opposing Pokémon with an attack from a void and restores the user's HP
darkrai.hypnosis: Has the user employ hypnotic suggestion in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and making them fall asleep after a short time.
darkrai.dark void:
Has the user fire balls of darkness at opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, dealing damage and marking them. When the user deals damage to marked opposing Pokémon, the marks are removed and the opposing Pokémon falls asleep.

Upgrade (Level 11): Applies a 40% slow for 3s when applying a mark to an enemy.
darkrai.shadow claw:
Has the user slash in the designated direction with sharp claws made from shadows, dealing damage and marking opposing Pokémon it hits. When the user deals damage to marked opposing Pokémon, the mark is removed and the opposing Pokémon falls asleep. When this move hits, this move can be used agai and the user deals damage in the designated direction with huge claws.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the damage dealt by this move.
darkrai.calm mind: Has the user quietly focus its mind and calm its spirit to increase its Sp. Atk, Sp. Def and movement speed for a short time.
darkrai.nasty plot:
Has the user gain 1 Nasty Plot counter while moving in the designated direction. A maximum of 2 Nasty Plot counters can be stored. When the user uses its next basic attack or boosted attack, the user consumes all Nasty Plot counters and deals additional damage based on the number of counters consumed.

Upgrade (Level 13): Gain one charge of this move in reserve when an enemy falls asleep.
darkrai.dark pulse:
Has the user hide in a circle of shadow and creates six additional circles of shadow around itself. While the circles of shadow are active, the user can move between them freely. When this move is used again, the user appears from the designated circle of shadow and releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. While the user is hiding in a circle of shadow, it can use Shadow Claw to attack with claws from that shadow and deal damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.

Upgrade (Level 13): Dealing damage with this move causes Darkrai to gain a shield for 2.5 seconds.
darkrai.worst nightmare: Has the user send the designated opposing Pokémon into a nightmare. The user then suddenly appears in the nightmare. When the user deals damage to the opposing Pokémon inside the nightmare, damage is also dealt to that same opposing Pokémon outside of the nightmare. When this move is used, all the user's move cooldowns are reset.
darkrai.bad dreams: When an enemy is forcibly put to sleep near Darkrai, Darkrai deals damage to the target and gains a boosted attack. When Darkrai uses this boosted, every enemy that has been marked with bad dreams in the last 2.7s is attacked simultaneously.  Sleeping enemies near Darkrai take damage over time, and Darkrai deals 10% more damage to them while they remain asleep. Damage from this Ability doesn't wake up sleeping enemies.

dhelmise.basic attack: Has the user attack by slamming its body
dhelmise.payback: Has the user swing its anchor, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon it hits. The user deals increased damage if opposing Pokémon hit the user with an attack while this move is being used.
dhelmise.power whip:
Has the user slash its anchor horizontally in front of itself, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect when it hits and granting the user a shield. The edge of the anchor deals additional damage and leaves the opposing Pokémon it hits unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the duration opposing Pokémon are left unable to act to 1s.
dhelmise.whirlpool:
Has the user swing its anchor diagonally, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon. Every third time the move is used, it generates a whirlpool centered on the user, pulling in nearby opposing Pokémon. This move's cooldown is reduced every time the user hits with a basic attack.

Upgrade (Level 13): Further reduces this move's cooldown by 1.5s every time the user hits with a basic attack.
dhelmise.bulldoze: Has the user shake the ground by slamming its anchor dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them.
dhelmise.anchor shot:
Has the user throw its anchor in the designated direction and catch an opposing Pokémon with it, dealing damage and leaving it uanble to act. The user then pulls the opposing Pokémon toward itself.

vaporeon.run away: Restores the Pokémon's HP and nullifies damage from Pokémon from the opposing team. This Ability goes on a 30s cooldown after it's triggered.

zacian.basic attack: If basic attacks are performed consecutively within a set time, the effects of the second and subsequent basic attack stages will change as described below. (When the Pokémon is using a move, this set time is extended. ) Stage two: The user deals damage to opposing Pokémon and decreases their movement speed. Stage three: The user deals damage to opposing Pokémon while restoring its own HP. Stage four: The user quickly draws near an opposing Pokémon and deals damage to it. All of the user's move cooldowns are reduced.
zacian.slash: Has the user deal damage to an opposing Pokémon and deal a small amount of damage to nearby opposing Pokémon. When this move is boosted with Aeos energy, its area of effect is increased, it deals increased damage, and it also decreases opposing Pokémon's movement speed for a short time.
zacian.metal claw:
as the user release a shock wave in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed. As the shock wave moves forward, it negates projectile attacks from opposing Pokémon it hits. After releasing the shock wave, the user also charges and deals damage to opposing Pokémon. If this charge hits an opposing Pokémon, the user's basic attack speed is increased for a short time. When this move is boosted with Aeos energy, the shock wave's size and travel distance are increased. Also, the movement speed of opposing Pokémon hit by the shock wave is further decreased.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.
zacian.sacred sword:
Has the user slash around itself as if drawing a circle with the tip of its sword, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed. The user then unleashes a slashing attack inside the circle, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them unable to act. After this move hits an opposing Pokémon, the user's Attack is increased for a short time, and damage dealt by the user's moves and basic attacks partially ignores the opposing Pokémon's Defense. When this move is boosted with Aeos energy, its area of effect is increased, and the time until the slashing attack is unleashed is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduce the time until the flurry of slashes is unleashed to 1.2s for the base Sacred Sword+ and 0.45s for Boosted Sacred Sword+.
zacian.quick attack: Has the user charge in the designated direction, stop in place when it hits an opposing Pokémon, and deal damage to it. When this move is boosted with Aeos energy, it also leaves opposing Pokémon unable to act for a short time.
zacian.agility:
Removes any hindrances applied to the user and greatly increases the user's movement speed. After a short time, the movement speed increase weakens and stays that way for a set amount of time. The effect duration is increased if the user is in combat with Pokémon from the opposing team. When this move is boosted with Aeos energy, the user's movement speed is further increased, and the user is also granted a shield.

Upgrade (Level 13): Further increases movement speed gain to 40% on use.
zacian.play rough:
Has the user leap in the designated direction, dealing damage to an opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them unable to act. The user lands near the opposing Pokémon it hit and deals damage to nearby opposing Pokémon. Damage taken by the user is reduced for a short time after landing. When this move is boosted with Aeos energy, the user leaps further and will no longer stop in place when hitting an opposing Pokémon, and all opposing Pokémon hit along the leap's path will receive damage and be left unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the stun duration to 0.75s.
zacian.sovereign sword: Has the user ready its giant sword, charge the sword with Aeos energy, and then slash in front of itself. The user becomes immune to hindrances while the Unite Move button is held down and the user is in its ready stance. The longer the user is in this stance, the more Aeos energy is charged into the sword, and the more damage this move deals. If a set amount of Aeos energy or more is charged into the sword, the Unite Move becomes boosted, and the slash's area of effect increases. This boosted Unite Move deals increased damage to opposing Pokémon it hits who have been buffed by their own Unite Move.
zacian.intrepid sword: If the goal scoring button is held down, Zacian charges its sword  with Aeos energy. For a short time, its basic attacks become boosted attacks. In addition, during this time, Zacian can use a boosted version of one of its moves once (this use does not share the same cooldown as the base move). The longer the goal scoring button is held down, the more Aeos energy is charged into the sword, lengthening the duration of the boost effect on basic attacks and moves. This Ability goes on an 8s cooldown after it’s triggered.

zapdos.basic attack: Has the user hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. Whenever a set amount of time passes, the user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack, launching a powerful electric orb and dealing damage to opposing Pokémon. If this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, the user's boosted attack cooldowns are reduced.
zapdos.thunder shock: Has the user attack with a jolt of electricity. If this move hits an opposing Pokémon, it also zaps a nearby opposing Pokémon, dealing damage to it.
zapdos.thunderbolt:
Has the user unleash a strong electric blast to the designated area, dealing damage and paralyzing opposing Pokémon. An electric field is left in the move's area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown by 6% of the current cooldown for each Pokémon hit.
zapdos.discharge: Has the user let loose a flare of electricity from its feathers, dealing damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and leaving them paralyzed. If there is an electric field within this move's area of effect, the electric field is absorbed, increasing this move's area of effect and duration.
zapdos.zap cannon:
Has the user fire an electric cannon-like blast that explodes on contact, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon caught in the explosion's area of effect. When the electric orb passes through an electric field, it absorbs the electric field, increasing its size, travel distance, and damage dealt to opposing Pokémon. Opposing Pokémon caught in the explosion are also left unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): When the electric orb passes through an electric field, the orb's size increases, along with the duration opposing Pokémon are left unable to act.
zapdos.high-voltage siege:
Has the user continuously drop lightning bolts in the designated area, creating an electric field where the lightning strikes. The lightning bolts paralyze and deal damage to opposing Pokémon they hit.

If lightning bolts hit the same opposing Pokémon 3 consecutive times, that Pokémon will be left unable to act.

If lightning bolts hit one of the opposing team's goal zones 5 times, that goal zone will become defenseless, and 1 ally Pokémon will be able to score immediately.
zapdos.static: When the user receives damage from nearby Pokémon from the opposing team, the damaging Pokémon becomes paralyzed. This Ability goes on a 15s cooldown when triggered. When the user hits with a boosted attack, Thunder Shock, or Thunderbolt, they create an electric field. This field will remain for 3s, dealing damage and slowing opposing Pokémon in it by 30%.

yveltal.gust:
Has the user attack with a gust of wind from its wings, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon.

After traveling a set distance, the gust leaves behind a breeze, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.
yveltal.oblivion wing:
Has the user unleash a destructive ray in the designated direction, restoring the user's HP based on the damage dealt. If the Pokémon exceeds its max HP, a set percentage is converted into a shield effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the damage dealt by this move.
yveltal.lash out: Has the user lash out in the designated area, dealing damage over time to opposing Pokémon. The last hit deals damage and leaves the opposing Pokémon unable to act.
yveltal.dark pulse:
Has the user unleash a malicious orb in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and leaving them unable to act.

When the orb travels a set distance or this move hits opposing Pokémon, the orb detonates, dealing damage over time and applying a slow effect to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces this move's cooldown.
yveltal.lumiere of demise:
Has the user fire a violent beam of light at the designated location, dealing continuous damage to opposing Pokémon in the beam's area of effect.

The longer the beam is fired, the larger the area of effect. Afterward, it creates an explosion, dealing increased damage to opposing Pokémon.

While firing the beam, the user is resistant to hindrances.
yveltal.dark aura:
When the Pokémon deals damage to opposing Pokémon with a boosted attack, a move, or its Unite Move, the hit Pokémon's destruction counter increases. The higher the hit Pokémon's destruction counter, the more damage it receives.

When Pokémon from the opposing team have a maxed destruction counter and take damage from this Pokémon's moves, they are immediately knocked out if their HP drops below a certain percentage.

When this Pokémon immediately knocks out a Pokémon from the opposing team, its own HP is restored. If the Pokémon exceeds its max HP, a set percentage is converted into a shield effect.

absol.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and lowering their Defense by 15% for 2s when it hits. If this boosted attack hits only a single target, it deals increased damage.
absol.feint: Dash in an arc, attacking enemies that come in contact with Absol. This move ignores the defense stat and shield effects of enemies.
absol.night slash:
Dash in an outward arc, dealing damage to enemies. If this first attack hits, a second attack can also be performed. The second attack has the user dash straight ahead, dealing damage to enemies and increasing the user's critical-hit rate. The lower the enemies HP, the more the user's critical-hit rate is increased.

Upgrade (Level 11): Using this move again will restore the user's HP.
absol.pursuit:
Dash to the designated location and quickly charge an enemy with the next basic attack. (Basic attack range is doubled while this effect is active). If the basic attack lands from behind, its damage is increased and this move's cooldown is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased movement speed.
absol.slash: Slash with sharp claws in front of the user, increasing this move's critical-hit rate.
absol.psycho cut:
Attack with blades formed by psychic power that decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits. Also increases basic attack damage dealt to the affected enemy for up to 3 attacks after this move hits.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also increases movement speed for a short time when the user gets close to the enemy that this move hit.
absol.sucker punch:
Look for an opening to attack an enemy, decreasing the movement speed of the user and the target enemy for the duration. After a short time, charge forward to attack the enemy. However, if the user receives damage or gets attacked before it charges, attack immediately and shove the enemy.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases basic attack speed for a short time when this move hits.
absol.midnight slash: Unleashes a flurry of slashes in front of the user. This move ends by unleashing powerful blades of energy, dealing increased damage to enemies and shoves them.

aegislash.attack: Slash at enemies in front of Aegislash, dealing damage to them. If the boost count is one or more, basic attacks become a boosted attack. When in Blade Stance: pierce through enemies, dealing damage. When in Shield Stance: ram enemies, dealing damage and leaving them unable to act for a short time, restore HP, and reduce the cooldown of Sacred Sword and Shadow Claw when this attack hits. Every boosted attack consumes one boost count. Up to 4 boosted boosted attacks can be stored.
aegislash.shadow sneak: Cast a shadow in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. After the shadow hits an enemy or travels its maximum distance, Aegislash warps to the shadow’s location, dealing damage to nearby enemies and increase boost count by 1.
aegislash.sacred sword:
Aegislash thrusts its blade into the ground, creating a triangular zone. This zone erupts with a hidden power, dealing damage to enemies in the area and throws them. Also increases boost count by 1 for each enemy hit (capped at 2 for wilds, 4 for players). At the same time as the eruption, Aegislash slashes forward, dealing additional damage to enemies hit. For a short time after this slash hits, damage dealt by Aegislash partially ignores the Defense of all enemies.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increase Attack for a short time after hitting enemies with this move.
aegislash.shadow claw:
Aegislash slashes with its blade twice in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Follow up with a final rising slash that deals damage to enemies hit and throw them. Boost count increases by 1 when at least one of the three slashes hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases Critical-Hit Rate with all attacks and moves except for Coup de Grace for a short time.
aegislash.iron defense: Envelops Aegislash in a powerful protective force for 1s. The protection disappears after blocking one attack or after 1s and then increases boost count by 1.
aegislash.wide guard:
Focus in place for a short time to create a great shield on Aegislash. When this shield appears, boost count increases by 1, granting a shield to Aegislash and shoves enemies in front. While this shield is active, enemy player attacks increase boost count by 1 for each different enemy player (capping at 4). When this move ends, shove enemies in front of Aegislash once again.

Upgrade (Level 13): Cooldown reduced by 1s.
aegislash.iron head:
Dash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. Also increases boost count by 1, and protects Aegislash with a special shield for a short time afterward. This shield doesn’t protect from hindrances, but it can nullify damage. When the shield blocks an attack, it disappears and boost count is increased by 1.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increase Attack for a short time after blocking an attack.
aegislash.coup de grace: Unleash a ground-splitting slash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The lower their remaining HP, the more damage this move deals. If this slash knocks out an enemy, boost count increases by 1.
aegislash.no guard: Honedge and Doublade do not gain the stat benefits of Stance Change. However, their boosted attack functions like Aegislash's Sword Stance boosted attack.

azumarill.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage to enemies within a cone area of effect in front of this Pokémon.
azumarill.tackle: Charge forward, dealing damage to any enemy hit and leave them unable to act for a short time.
azumarill.play rough:
Increases movement speed for a short time and changes the next basic attack. When Azumarill performs their next basic attack, lunge at one enemy in range and deliver repeated blows; dealing damage to that target and leave it unable to act for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 12): Further increases movement speed when this move is used, and also reduces this move’s cooldown.
azumarill.water pulse:
Shoot a pulsing blast of water in front of Azumarill. When the blast of water hits an enemy, decrease that Pokémon’s movement speed and deal damage to all enemies in an area of effect around the initial target hit. The blast of water then automatically bounces to another target if one is available. Including the first target, the blast of water can bounce between up to 3 targets consecutively, and each hit behaves in the same way as the first. While the blast of water is traveling, Azumarill can perform a short rolling dash in a designated direction.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increase the maximum number of targets that the blast of water can bounce between by 2.
azumarill.bubble: Spray bubbles in a cone; dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. This move can be used while moving.
azumarill.whirlpool:
For a short time, four small whirlpools appear that swirl around Azumarill as they move. If a whirlpool hits an enemy, the whirlpool deals damage and restores Azumarill's HP. If a whirlpool hits an enemy player, an increased amount of HP is restored.

Upgrade (Level 10): Reduce this move’s cooldown and increases the amount of HP it restored.
azumarill.aqua tail:
Increases the speed and area of effect of Azumarill's next 3 basic attacks. If these basic attacks hit from a distance, they also deal increased damage, restore Azumarill's HP, and can ignore the Defense stat and shield effects of enemies hit.

Upgrade (Level 10): After activating this move, Azumarill's next 3 basic attacks will also reduce the cooldown of all moves when they hit an enemy from a distance.
azumarill.belly bash: Azumarill pounds their belly 3 times, granting a shield. With each pound, Azumarill loses HP in exchange for increased Attack. Azumarill can move while pounding their belly. Afterward, target an enemy and then charge at the target; dealing damage to them and throwing all enemies hit while charging.
azumarill.huge power: When this Pokémon hits only a single enemy with a basic attack, a move, or their Unite Move, the hit is always a critical hit. However, when hitting two or more enemies at once with a basic attack, a move, or its Unite Move, the hits are never critical hits.

blastoise.attack: Blastoise’s third auto attack is empowered - dealing 3 instances of damage, slowing enemies hit and reducing Blastoise’s move cooldowns by 1 second each.
blastoise.water gun: Attacks with a shot of water, shoving enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
blastoise.hydro pump:
Has the user attack by blasing out a huge volume of water, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and shoving them when it hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases damage dealt by this move.
blastoise.water spout:
Spouts water toward the designated location, decreasing the movement speed of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases damage dealt by this move.
blastoise.skull bash: Fiercely rams an opposing Pokémon and leaves it unable to act.
blastoise.surf:
Has the user charge forward on a wave, shoving enemies and leaving them unable to act. The user becomes immune to hindrances while using this move and can jump in a designated direction once this move ends.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also grants a shield when this move hits.
blastoise.rapid spin:
Has the user spin rapidly, changing the mechanics of its basic attacks as well as its Hydro Pump and Water Spout moves.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also reduces the damage the user receives while using this move.
blastoise.hydro typhoon: Has the user spout water to attack while spinning, throwing enemies in a large area. This also grants the user a shield.
blastoise.torrent: When the Pokémon is at half HP or less, its Attack and Sp. Attack are increased.

blissey.attack: Becomes a boosted attack after a set amount of time passes, dealing increased damage.
blissey.pound: Has the user attack by pounding in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when it hits.
blissey.egg bomb:
Hurls an egg at the designated location. The egg then explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throwing them.

Upgrade (Level 12): Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are thrown by this move.
blissey.helping hand:
For a short time, greatly increases the user's and nearby allies movement speed and basic attack speed. While this move's effects last, all of the user's basic attacks become boosted attacks.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases the damage of basic attacks while this move's effects last.
blissey.heal pulse: Continually restores the user's and designated ally HP for a short time.
blissey.soft-boiled:
Throws an egg to an ally, restoring its HP as well as the user's HP. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move and cannot be used more than once every 2s.

Upgrade (Level 10): Increases the maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve.
blissey.safeguard:
Blissey grants both the targeted ally and themself a shield, purging hindrances and making both immune to hindrances as long as the shield lasts.

Upgrade (Level 10): Shield value increased.
blissey.bliss assistance: Has the user dash to the designated ally to give it an egg, granting that ally a shield and increasing its Attack and Sp. Attack for a short time. The user also intercepts a portion of the damage received by that ally for a short time. While dashing, the user throws nearby enemies and those it comes in contact with.
blissey.natural cure: Removes all status condition from the Pokémon. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

cinderace.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits.
cinderace.ember: Shoot out a small flame, dealing damage to enemies, leaving them burned and decreasing their Attack for a short time.
cinderace.pyro ball:
Kick a ball of flame in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies and leaving them burned for a short time when this move hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces the cooldown of Flame Charge or Feint when this move hits.
cinderace.blaze kick:
Perform a fiery flying kick. This move is always a critical hit, and it shoves enemies and leaves them burned for a short time. In addition, become immune to hindrances while using this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases basic attack speed for a short time when this move hits.
cinderace.low sweep: Make a swift low sweep in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemy it hits.
cinderace.flame charge:
Charge forward cloaked in flame, dealing damage to any enemy hit.

Upgrade (Level 13): The next boosted attack after this move ends also decreases the movement speed of enemies hit for a short time.
cinderace.feint:
Increases movement speed for a short time and become invincible.

Upgrade (Level 13): After this move is used, basic attacks that hit enemies restore HP (up to 3 times).
cinderace.blazing bicycle kick: Create a giant ball of flame and kick it toward the designated location. The ball releases a fierce shock wave that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also increases movement speed by 10% (stacks with the Unite Buffs) for 5s when it hits.
cinderace.blaze: When using a move, the next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. When hitting an enemy with a basic attack or move, a cinder is placed on that enemy. Attacking a cindered enemy a certain number of times will cause the cinder to flare, dealing damage to the enemy. When at half HP or less, critical-hit rate is increased by 10% and basic attack speed is increased by 20% for a short time.

cramorant.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every fourth attack. This boosted attack spits Arrokuda or other Pokémon at the enemy and deals area damage near the target when it hits.
cramorant.whirlpool: Creates a whirlpool that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. The area of effect slowly shrinks, but the damage dealt slowly increases. Just before the whirlpool disappears, it decreases the movement speed of enemies in the area of effect for a short time. The user can also catch Arrokuda or other prey by entering the whirlpool.
cramorant.surf:
Attacks with a wave that deals damage to enemies. Once the wave has traveled its full distance, it returns the way it came, dealing damage to enemies once again and pulling them back with the wave. The user can also catch Arrokuda or other prey by entering the wave.

Upgrade (Level 13): When the first wave hits enemies, it also decreases their movement speed for a short time.
cramorant.dive:
Changes the designated area into a puddle and has the user dive to that area, dealing damage to enemies and shoving them when they're hit. The user also catches Arrokuda or other wild Pokémon as they emerge from the puddle. A maximum of 3 uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
cramorant.feather dance: Decreases the Attack and movement speed of enemies for a short time.
cramorant.hurricane:
Creates a fierce wind, dealing damage to enemies that get caught in it and throws them.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the user's movement speed for a short time.
cramorant.air slash:
Shoot out many blades of air while moving backward to create distance. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and reduces this move's cooldown when it hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Restores the user's HP every time a blade of air hits an enemy.
cramorant.gatling gulp missile: Creates a puddle at the user's current location. The user continuously uses its mouth to grab Arrokuda from the puddle and spits them out to attack the nearest enemy. The user cannot move or use other moves while this move is in effect.
cramorant.gulp missile: When Cramorant uses a move, it catches some form of prey in its mouth. Afterward, when Cramorant receives damage, it spits the prey out as a counterattack at an enemy. The type of prey and effect differ based on the user's HP.

crustle.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
crustle.rock slide: Drops large rocks on the designated area. When this move hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaves them unable to act for a short time.
crustle.rock tomb:
Splits open the ground toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and creating a barricade of rock. Activating this move again removes the barricade.

Upgrade (Level 11): Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
crustle.shell smash:
Convert a set percentage of Defense and Sp. Defense into Attack and Sp. Attack and increase movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased conversion rate.
crustle.fury cutter: Slashes enemies with claws, dealing damage to them. Hitting the same enemy multiple times in succession with this move increases the damage dealt.
crustle.stealth rock:
Throws many small rocks. When a rock hits an enemy or when the rocks have flown their full distance, a zone of many levitating rocks is created dealing slowly-increasing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the duration of this move's effects and decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
crustle.x-scissor:
Dash forward with crossed claws, dealing damage to enemies multiple times and shoving them. Leaves enemies unable to act if they hit an object when shoved.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduced cooldown.
crustle.rubble rouser: Gain a shield for a short time and leave nearby enemies unable to act, dealing damage over time to them. If the user receives damage while this move is in effect, the move deals additional hits to nearby enemies.
crustle.sturdy: Gains a stacking Def/SpDef buff for every 7% HP missing. Stacks up to 10 times.

decidueye.attack: Increases the speed of basic attacks by 3% for a short time after one hits. This effect can stack up to 4 times, and with every third activation of this effect, basic attacks become boosted attacks for a short time. These boosted attacks fire more quills, but the damage dealt by each quill is decreased.
decidueye.leafage: Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack and basic attack speed are increased.
decidueye.razor leaf:
Summons whirling razor leaves. For a short time after using this move, Decidueye’s Attack and basic attack speed are increased, and basic attacks can target multiple enemies for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the basic attack damage the higher the enemies remaining HP is.
decidueye.spirit shackle:
Charges power before firing quills in the designated direction. Damage dealt increases the longer power is charged, but movement speed is decreased while charging. If this move hits after power is charged to the maximum, it can stitch enemies to the ground. The affected Pokémon receives damage upon moving a set distance from that location, and their movement speed is decreased for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Deals increased damage to enemies with low remaining HP.
decidueye.astonish: Deals damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
decidueye.leaf storm:
Creates a tempest of sharp leaves, dealing damage to enemies it hits and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At point-blank range, it also shoves enemies hit.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the length of time that the movement speed of enemies is decreased.
decidueye.shadow sneak:
Creates a shadow that takes hold of one enemy in the area of effect, dealing damage and decreasing their movement speed and Defense for a short time. Also increases Decidueye’s movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 13): Further decreases Defense.
decidueye.nock nock: Fires quills in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The move ends by unleashing a particularly large quill that deals damage to all enemies it hits. This move deals increased damage if the enemies remaining HP is low. While using this move, Decidueye becomes immune to hindrances but is unable to move.
decidueye.long reach: Deals increased damage to distant enemies.

delphox.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits.
delphox.ember: Shoot a small flame in front of itself, dealing damage to enemies hit.
delphox.fire blast:
Launch an intense, all-consuming fire in a forward direction; dealing damage to enemies hit. As the fire travels, it leaves behind a zone of flames in which a delayed explosion will occur, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
delphox.mystical fire:
Unleash a special, hot ball of fire in a forward direction. If it hits an enemy, the fire will explode; dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also reduces cooldowns of all moves if this move hits. If it hits an enemy from the opposing team, cooldowns are reduced even further.
delphox.will-o-wisp: Conjure up three sinister flames and launch them toward the designated area. These flames then explode; dealing damage to enemies hit by the explosion and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 2s.
delphox.fire spin:
Create a vortex of fire in the designated area. The vortex automatically moves toward the nearest enemy, dealing damage-over-time to all enemies caught in the area for a short time and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for 5s. After 4.5s passes or an enemy is caught in the center of the vortex; the flames increase in intensity. This increases the rate at which the flames deal damage and also leaves the enemies unable to act for 1s. This trapped damage ticks four times total. The Fire Spin will otherwise deal damage as it travels. Move placement on top of enemies will apply a "searching" tick and then apply "trapped" damage. A maximum of 9 ticks is possible.

Upgrade (Level 13): Applies a debuff on trap activation that increases all damage dealt by Delphox by 15% while enemies are trapped. Debuff is only cleansable after the first tick of trap damage and does not re-apply the debuff.
delphox.flame charge:
Charge forward in the designated direction. If there are any enemies in range when the charge ends, summon three flames to attack. The flames deal damage and decrease enemy movement speed for a short time. This move can be used while also using Fire Blast or Mystical Fire.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases Delphox's movement speed for a short time when this move is used.
delphox.fanciful fireworks: Deals damage-over-time to enemies in the designated area-of-effect. Enemies that are hit have decreased movement speed and weakened HP recovery effects for a short time.
delphox.blaze: When using a move while at low remaining HP, deal additional damage with a fireball to enemies. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered.

dodrio.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing consecutive blows with each of the user's heads. When the sprint gauage is full, basic attacks will cause the Pokémon to charge in the direction they're facing and consume all of the sprint gauge. If this charging attack hits an enemy, all of the user's move cooldowns are reduced.
dodrio.peck: Move forward while jabbing with beaks. When the sprint gauge is full, instead charge forward while jabbing with beaks. Using this move fully consumes the sprint gauge.
dodrio.tri attack:
Dodrio attacks with their beaks in a cone in front of themself, dealing damage to enemies and applying one of the following random effects to enemies hit: decrease Attack and deal damage-over-time for a set amount of time, decrease auto attack speed, or decrease movement speed. When the sprint gauge is full, Dodrio instead shoots out 3 projectiles in a designated direction. If a projectile hits an enemy, the projectile deals damage and applies one of the aforementioned effects based on its color. After this move is used, Dodrio's next auto attack deals additional damage and restores HP. Holds 2 uses in reserve and cannot be used more than once every 1s.

Upgrade (Level 11): When the sprint gauge is full, this move's cooldown is reduced.
dodrio.drill peck:
Dodrio moves forward while striking with their sharp beaks multiple times, dealing damage to enemies hit. When the sprint gauge is full, Dodrio instead dashes forward while striking with their sharp beaks multiple times, dealing damage to enemies hit and shoving them. Using this move fully consumes the sprint gauge.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown. Also, when this move hits enemies, restore a portion of Dodrio's HP based on the amount of damage dealt.
dodrio.quick attack: Dash forward, increasing the user's movement speed for a short time and deal damage to enemies hit. This move's cooldown is reduced if it hits an enemy.
dodrio.agility:
Become immune to hindrances for a short time and fully charge the sprint gauge. Afterward, movement speed is increased for a short time, and the sprint gauge charges faster.

Upgrade (Level 13): After this move is used, the sprint gauge becomes fully charged.
dodrio.jump kick:
Dodrio leaps forward while kicking. If this move makes contact with an enemy or obstacle, Dodrio leaps over it and stomps the ground when landing, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time and the sprint gauge charges. If this move makes contact with an enemy, this move's cooldown is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 13): When stomping the ground after leaping, enemies in the area are also left unable to act.
dodrio.triple trample: Dodrio runs to a designated location. While running, Dodrio is immune to hindrances. If Dodrio makes contact with an enemy while running, they are dealt damage and thrown into the air. When Dodrio arrives at the designated location, Dodrio gains increased Attack for a short time, is granted a shield, and the sprint gauge charges faster for a short time.
dodrio.run away: Movement speed is increased when enemies are nearby. While the Pokémon is moving, their sprint gauge charges. While the sprint gauge is full, movement speed is increased. If the Pokémon's movement speed decreases below a set speed, the sprint gauge will rapidly deplete. When this Pokémon scores a goal, the amount of Aeos energy deposited is evenly divided into equal portions for each head the Pokémon has.

dragapult.attack: Each time damage is dealt to enemies, boosted basic attack gauge increases. When the boosted basic attack gauge is full (after 8 instances of damage), the Pokémon's basic attacks become boosted attacks.
dragapult.astonish: Lets out a sound blast in a forward direction. The shout explodes when it hits an enemy or after traveling a set distance, dealing damage in the area and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
dragapult.dragon breath:
Exhales a mighty gust in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed. The gust also leaves the ground burning for a set amount of time. Pokémon in this area of effect take damage over tim and have their movement speed decreased for a short time. If this move is used while the uesr is flying with Dragon Dance, the mighty gust is exhaled along Dragon Dance's flight path, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and the decreasing their movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 13): Deals increased damage and further decreases their movement speed.
dragapult.shadow ball:
Hurls a shadowy blob in the designated direction, dealing damage to Pokémon it touches and applying a mark to them. When marked Pokémon are hit by Dragapult, they receive additional damage. The fourth time the marked Pokémon is hit, the mark is removed, but the damage dealt by the attack is further increased and the user recovers HP. After using this move, the user moves a short distance in a designated direction.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased Damage.
dragapult.quick attack: Dashes in the designated direction, increasing its basic attack speed for a short time.
dragapult.dragon dance:
Flies in a circular pattern in the designated direction. While flying, it continuously deals damage to nearby enemies with basic attacks that deal less damage but have increased attack speed. If this move is used again while the user is flying, the user stops flying and moves a short distance in the designated direction. If the user knocks out an enemy, this move's cooldown is reset. If the user assists in a knock out, this move's cooldown is reduced by half. When this move is used, Dragon's Breath's cooldown is reset.

Upgrade (Level 11): While the user is flying, its attacks also restores HP when they hit.
dragapult.phantom force:
For a short time, increases the user's movement speed and enters stealth. While the user is in stealth, the boosted basic attack gauge increases. When stealth ends, Dragapult's basic attack speed is increased for a short time. After this move is learned, if the user knocks out an enemy, this move's cooldown is reset and Dragapult's Attack is increased by 6 until the end of battle. This Attack increase can stack up to 8 times.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown by 0.5s when the user deals damage to enemies with basic attacks.
dragapult.dreep and destroy: Launches two Dreepy and each deals damage to different Pokémon in the area of effect. The lower the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP is, the more damage the Dreepy deal. If there is only one target in the area of effect, both Dreepy target that Pokémon and deal damage to it. A maximum of 2 uses can be kept in reserve for this move. Dreepy may be fired once every 2 seconds. Neither Cooldown Reduction nor gaining Aeos Energy reduce the cooldown of Dreep and Destroy.
dragapult.clear body: Reduces the duration of debuff effects inflicted on Dragapult by 50%.

dragonite.attack - dratini: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, blasting water in front of Dratini, dealing increased damage, reducing the cooldown of Dratini's moves by 1s, and recover 5% max HP when this hits.
dragonite.twister: Creates a twister and releases it in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
dragonite.dragon dance:
Dash in a designated direction, in one of three cycling patterns. After using this move, grant a buff increasing attack speed, movement speed, Attack by 8% (capping at 24%), as well as increasing the stage of Hyper Beam. This buff stacks up to 3 times, and the duration is reset to full on reuse. All stacks are removed after a few seconds. Basic attacks reduce the cooldown of this ability by 1s.

Upgrade (Level 11): Further increases Dragonite's movement speed by 10% for 4.5s if there are enemies nearby when the dance ends.
dragonite.extreme speed:
Dash toward the designated location stopping upon contact with an enemy, dealing damage and throwing them.

Upgrade (Level 11): If Dragonite's movement speed is currently decreased when this move is used, that movement speed decrease is negated before the move is used.
dragonite.dragon breath: Exhale a mighty gust in the designated direction. If this move hits an enemy, the user's next attack becomes a boosted attack.
dragonite.hyper beam:
Fires a beam of energy toward the targeted enemy after a delay, dealing damage to all enemies that it hits, as well as additional damage based on their Max HP. The move changes Stages based on the number of stacks of Dragon Dance that Dragonite has, from 0 to 3. The Max HP damage is 5%/10%/15%/20%, determined by the current Stage.  Dragonite cannot act during the duration of this move.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces damage taken by 50% while charging this move.
dragonite.outrage:
Dragonite begins rampaging for 5s. This move starts with a ground stomp, dealing damage to enemies in an area around Dragonite. While rampaging, all of Dragonite's basic attacks become a melee boosted attack, alternating through the water, electric, and fire boosted attack types. When the rampage ends, Dragonite is left briefly unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduce the duration of hindrances inflicted on Dragonite while rampaging by 40% for 5.5s.
dragonite.draco impact: Briefly fly up in the air before crashing down with several comets on a designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies in the area. The farther Dragonite flies, the more the Unite guage is consumed (25% at min disatance and 100% at max). Dragonite is unstoppable while using this move.
dragonite.marvel scale: Increases Defense by 100 for 1.5s when afflicted by a status condition (Dratini and Dragonair only).

duraludon.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, shooting a long beam that deals a large amount of damage to all enemies hit.
duraludon.laser focus: Reduces damage received for a short time. Afterward, Duraludon's basic attacks deal additional damage to enemies hit. This buff expires after 8s or after 3 basic attacks.
duraludon.flash cannon:
Duraludon ruptures the ground around themself and in a designated direction; dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed by 50% for 1s. Afterward, go into "Cannon Mode" rooting Duraludon for 6s or if a basic attack is not made for 2.5s or this move can be cancelled early. While in Cannon Mode, basic attacks have longer range, attack speed is increased by 100% but decays by 20% per second over 5 seconds, dealing increased damage and splash damage. Exiting "Cannon mode" will prematurely remove the attack speed buff. Metal Claw, Stealth Rock, Dragon Tail, and boosted attacks can be used while in this mode and boosted attacks decrease the movement speed of enemies hit by 60% for 1s and also pierce.

Upgrade (Level 11): Enemies in the ruptured ground's area of effect are also unable to act for 1s.
duraludon.dragon pulse:
Charges power before dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Duraludon's movement speed is decreased while charging, but the longer power is charged, the wider the move's area of effect becomes and the more damage it deals. After learning this move, a damage marker will be attached to any enemy Duraludon damages. When Dragon Pulse hits a marked enemy, it deals additional damage to that target for each damage marker attached to it, then removes all of the damage markers. In addition, if this move knocks out an enemy, the cooldown is reduced by 50% and the next 3 basic attacks will each deal additional damage and further reduce this move's cooldown when they hit.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also restores Duraludon's HP if this move knocks out an enemy player.
duraludon.metal claw: Strike with sharp claws; dealing damage to enemies hit and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. After this move is used, Duraludon's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
duraludon.dragon tail:
Duraludon shoves enemies and moves itself backward a short distance. The next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. A maximum of two uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 1.1s cooldown between uses. This move can penetrate through walls.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
duraludon.stealth rock:
