Hurl a stone at the designated area, creating an invisible field of stones. The field deals damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time. If the hurled stone hits an enemy before the designated area, the area of effect will instead be centered on where the stone hit that Pokémon. Once an enemy takes damage from the field, it will become visible to enemies.  If an enemy takes damage from this move 4 times, that enemy becomes unable to move for a short time. After this move is used, Duraludon's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. A maximum of two uses can be kept in reserve for this move. There is a 1.1s cooldown between uses.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the maximum number of uses that can be kept in reserve for this move.
duraludon.revolving ruin: Fire a beam of light at the ground in a sweeping circle around Duraludon. If this beam hits an enemy, it deals damage to them, grants Duraludon a shield and increases their Attack by 8% for a short time. Both the shield effect and the Attack increase are strengthened for each enemy that is hit by the beam. Damage is dealt to any enemy in the area of effect after the beam of light is fired. A burning ring is also left where the beam of light touched the ground, and enemies that touch this ring take additional damage and have their movement speed decreased by 50% for 1s refreshing as damage continus to be taken from the burning ground.
duraludon.heavy metal: Prevents Duraludon from being thrown or shoved by the first attempt to shove or throw them. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered (50s cd).

eldegoss.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, attaching a bit of cotton fluff to the enemy. The user's basic attacks against an enemy with cotton fluff on it deal increased damage and decreases the enemies movement speed for a short time.
eldegoss.leafage: Pelt the target with leaves, decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time when it hits.
eldegoss.pollen puff:
Throws a Pollen Puff, which attaches to an enemy. The Pollen Puff restores HP for allies and deals damage to enemies.

Upgrade (Level 10): If a Pollen Puff attaches to enemies, it also deals them damage over time. If a Pollen Puff attaches to an ally, it also reduces the damage they receive.
eldegoss.leaf tornado:
Attack with a tornado of sharp leaves, leaving a path in its wake that increases ally movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 10): Also decreases the accuracy of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
eldegoss.synthesis: Restores the HP of the user and nearby allies.
eldegoss.cotton guard:
Protects the user and nearby allies with cotton. The cotton absorbs damage and when the move ends, the cotton restores some HP.

Upgrade (Level 12): Also increases the user's movement speed while using this move.
eldegoss.cotton spore:
Gathers spores around the user, increasing the user's movement speed while this move is in effect. The spores burst after a short time, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect, throwing them, and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 12): Reduced damage taken while using this move.
eldegoss.cotton cloud crash: Float into the air and become invincible. If used again, pound the ground, attacking and shoving enemies and restoring HP to allies in the area of effect.
eldegoss.cotton down: Damages an enemy and decreases its movement speed for a short time after receiving a certain amount of damage. When that happens, also recover HP and gain increased movement speed for a short time.

garchomp.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every fifth attack, dealing increased damage and restoring the user's HP. Every time a basic attack or move hits an enemy, basic attack speed is increased.
garchomp.sand attack: Hurls sand, narrowing the field of vision of enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. Also increases movement speed and basic attack speed.
garchomp.dig:
Burrow underground and move quickly in the designated direction, jumping out when coming in contact with an enemy or when traveling the maximum distance. This jump deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.

Upgrade (Level 11): Damage received is reduced for a short time after jumping out of the ground.
garchomp.dragon rush:
Back up to create distance before diving to attack in the designated direction, shoving enemies. The user can use Dragon Claw while creating distance at the start of this move to create a combo attack. (This move can crit).

Upgrade (Level 11): Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when they are shoved the maximum distance.
garchomp.bulldoze: Stomp down on the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
garchomp.earthquake:
Jump high into the air and crash forcefully to the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 13): Decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time if they are in this move's area of effect.
garchomp.dragon claw:
Attack twice in front of itself using its claws. The first attack deals damage to enemies and throws them. The second attack deals increased damage. After the move ends, basic attack speed is increased for a short time. (This move can crit).

Upgrade (Level 13): Increase damage dealt.
garchomp.livid outrage: Has the user unleash a powerful chain attack while dashing forward. The final attack throws enemies but also leaves the user unable to act for a short time.
garchomp.rough skin: When struck by a melee attack, a portion of the damage received is reflected back at the attacker.

gardevoir.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their Sp. Defense by 10% for a short time.
gardevoir.confusion: Attacks straight in the designated direction.
gardevoir.psychic:
After hitting an enemy or traveling its maximum distance, deals damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed and Sp. Defense by 20%, stacking up to 3 times.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduced cooldown.
gardevoir.moonblast:
Has the user attack while moving back to create distance. When the move's blast hits, it deals damage to enemies in a cone and leaves the enemy closest to the user unable to act for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also grants a shield when this move is used.
gardevoir.teleport: Has the user warp to the designated area, increasing the damage dealt by one basic attack after warping.
gardevoir.psyshock:
Attacks the designated location three times. This move's cooldown is reduced each time one of these attacks hits an enemy.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increase the damage this move deals each time one of its attacks hits.
gardevoir.future sight:
Sets a delayed explosion. When the explosion hits an enemy, it reduces this move's cooldown.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reset this move's cooldown when the explosion hits an enemy.
gardevoir.fairy singularity: Warps Space in the designated area, drawing in enemies to the center. Shoves and deals damage to enemies the instant the warped space disappears.
gardevoir.synchronize: When an enemy inflicts decreased movement speed or a damage-over-time condition on the Pokémon, the same is inflicted on that opponent. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

gengar.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an enemy and dealing damage.
gengar.will-o-wisp: Shoot multiple sinister flames, dealing damage to enemies and leaving them burned when it hits.
gengar.shadow ball:
Hurl a shadowy blob at the target, decreasing the movement speed and Sp. Defense of enemies for a short time when it hits.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
gengar.sludge bomb:
Hurl unsanitary sludge to the designated area, leaving enemies poisoned when it hits.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased poison duration.
gengar.lick: Attacks with the user's tongue and pulls enemies toward the user.
gengar.dream eater:
Puts enemies to sleep when it hits. If used again while a nearby enemy is asleep, the user appears behind the target and attacks, restoring HP and reducing the cooldown of Shadow Ball or Sludge Bomb.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage and HP restored.
gengar.hex:
Disappear and move to the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect when the user reappears. If this hits an enemy that is afflicted by a status condition, it deals increased damage and its cooldown is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
gengar.phantom ambush: Jump to the designated area and start sneaking with increased movement speed. If this move is used again, it deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
gengar.levitate: Increases movement speed by 10% when out of combat. (5s after leaving combat).

glaceon.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and giving Glaceon 2 ice crystals when the boosted attack hits. Ice crystals last 5s and the duration is refreshed upon gaining additional crystals. Glaceon can hold a maximum of 8 ice crystals at a time.
glaceon.swift: Creates 4 stars around the user. For a short time afterward, each time the user hits an enemy with a basic attack, one of the stars (or 2 stars in the case of a boosted attack) will shoot out and deal additional damage to that enemy.
glaceon.icicle spear:
Has the user launch all of their stored ice crystals in rapid succession at the designated enemy. If no ice crystals are stored when this move is used, 2 ice crystals are instantly created and all crystals are launched. The crystals shatter when they hit the designated target, dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. Launched ice crystals can hit enemies on the opposing team that are not the designated target of this move. If this occurs, the ice crystals will still shatter on impact and deal damage in an area in the same way. Ice crystals launched by this move deal increasing damage each time they hit the same enemy. After this move is used, the cooldown of Ice Shard or Freeze-Dry is reduced.

Upgrade (Level 10): Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to enemies hit, equal to a set percentage of their max HP.
glaceon.icy wind:
Jump a short distance in the designated direction. Glaceon's next basic attack launches all stored ice crystals at an enemy, dealing damage to them. Glaceon then regains the same number of ice crystals that were launched. If Glaceon hits the same enemy with 1 or more ice crystals, that enemies movement speed is decreased for a short time. The more ice crystals that hit that target, the stronger this movement speed-decrease effect. If Glaceon has no ice crystals when this move is used, gain 2 ice crystals.

Upgrade (Level 10): Each launched ice crystal also deals additional damage to the enemy hit, equal to a set percentage of their max HP.
glaceon.tail whip: The user wags their tail at an enemy, dealing damage and decreasing their Defense, Sp. Def, and movement speed for a short time. The user's next basic attack after using this move becomes a boosted attack.
glaceon.ice shard:
Increase movement speed for a short time. Afterward, Glaceon's basic attack speed increases for a short time, and basic attacks change into attacks that hurl chunks of ice. These chunks of ice deal damage to enemies hit and decrease their movement speed for a short time. Every time a chunk of ice hits, the user gains 1 ice crystal. The user gains 2 ice crystals if this move is used while launching ice crystals with Icicle Spear, or if it's used after Icy Wind has been used, but before the user has launched all ice crystals with the next basic attack.

Upgrade (Level 12): Also increases basic attack speed for the duration of this move's effect.
glaceon.freeze dry:
Glaceon shoots out a freezing burst of air in a forward direction, increasing Sp. Atk for a short time. This burst explodes upon hitting an enemy or after traveling a set distance; dealing damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. For each enemy hit by the explosion, Glaceon gains 1 ice crystal. The explosion also leaves behind an ice zone. Enemies that enter this ice zone will have their movement speed decreased. If they remain in the ice zone for a set amount of time, they become frozen for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 12): For each enemy hit by this move's explosions; gain 1 ice crystal.
glaceon.glacial stage: Leap up high, creating an ice zone in front of Glaceon that deals damage to enemies in the area-of-effect. While Glaceon is in the ice zone, movement speed is increased and Glaceon gains 1 ice crystal whenever a set amount of time passes. The movement speed of enemies in the ice zone is decreased.
glaceon.run away: When Eevee would be affected by a hindrance, the hindrance is negated and becomes invincible for 1s. This Ability goes on cooldown after it’s triggered (70s cd).

greedent.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits and causing one berry to drop from Greedent's tail.
greedent.tackle: Leap to the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. If this move is used while Covet is active, no area can be designated for the user to leap to. Instead, while the user is running, damage is dealt in an area to enemies in front of Greedent. If Greedent has any berries stashed, consume all of them, reducing Tackle's cooldown for each berry consumed.
greedent.bullet seed:
Spit berry seeds in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. The more berries Greedent has stashed, the more damage this move deals.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
greedent.belch:
Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decrease their movement speed for a short time. If Greedent has any berries stashed, consume all of them, reducing Belch's cooldown for each berry consumed.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
greedent.defense curl: Grants Greedent a shield for a short time. In addition, a berry will drop in front of Greedent.
greedent.stuff cheeks:
Greedent drops several berries, which can be eaten to recover HP. Any HP recovered that exceeds Greedent's max HP will be converted to a shield. If Greedent catches sight of a berry while using this move, movement speed is increased for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increase the number of berries dropped.
greedent.covet:
Greedent runs with all its might, becoming unstoppable and dealing damage to enemies hit and throwing them. While running, Greedent drops berries. Eating a dropped berry increases movement speed for a short time. The more berries eaten, the more movement speed is increased. In addition, Belch or Bullet Seed can also be used while running.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage dealt and increased frequency of berries dropping.
greedent.berry belly flop: Greedent eats a berry to recover HP and then leaps to the designated area, dealing damage and throwing enemies within the area of effect. Greedent then eats a special berry, allowing an unlimited amount of berries to be stored for a short time and resets cooldowns of all moves.
greedent.cheek pouch: When Greedent eats a berry, recover HP after receiving the effects of the berry. At the same time, Greedent stashes another berry in its tail. Being hit by a single attack or combination of attacks will cause a berry to drop from Greedent's tail.

greninja.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. At long range, a boosted attack deals increased damage to enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time. At close range, a boosted attack deals more damage the lower the enemies remaining HP is.
greninja.bubble: Attack with a spray of bubbles, decreasing the movement speed of enemies when it hits.
greninja.water shuriken:
Throw shurikens made of water in quick succession. Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time and restores the user's HP when it hits. Also increases the user's movement speed while using this move.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the number of shurikens thrown.
greninja.surf:
Ride a wave, dealing damage to enemies and restoring the user's HP. If this move knocks out an enemy, its cooldown is reset. In addition, this move deals increased damage to enemies with low HP.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the amount of HP restored.
greninja.substitute: Leaves behind a substitute doll for the user while it's moving forward.
greninja.double team:
Quickly moves the user away from the current position, creating illusory copies of it to aid in battle.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduced cooldown.
greninja.smokescreen:
Creates a smokescreen and has the user roll away from its current location. Immediately afterward, the user begins sneaking and has its movement speed increased for a short time. This also makes its next basic attack a boosted attack.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased attack for a short time when the user stops sneaking.
greninja.waterburst shuriken: Throw a giant water shuriken toward the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when this move hits. The water shuriken then immediately explodes, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them. Once this move ends, the user may jump in a designated direction.
greninja.torrent: While HP is at 50% or less, Attack and movement speed are increased.

hoopa.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies by unleashing a beam of light. When Hoopa is unbound, every attack becomes a boosted attack and deals damage to up to 2 additional nearby enemies.
hoopa.astonish: Deals damage to enemies in the designated area of effect, leaving them unable to act for a short time.
hoopa.phantom force:
Hoopa creates a portal ring under itself and warps to a designated location, dealing damage to nearby enemies at that location and shoving them. Hoopa then shoots two sinister flames that deal damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed for a short time. This move can be used a second time within a set amount of time. If used a second time, Hoopa can return to the initial location they warped from. When using this move, if there is a nearby ally that is linked by Trick, that ally can also warp to the initial ring's location. The ally that warps in this way will recover HP.

Upgrade (Level 12): Become invincible for a short time when this move is used.
hoopa.shadow ball:
Unleash a shadowy blob in front of Hoopa, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed and Sp. Def for a short time. If Hoopa then hits the same enemy with a move or boosted attack within a set amount of time, it deals additional damage and leaves the enemy unable to act for a short time. When using this move, if there is a nearby ally linked by Trick, this move will also unleash a shadowy blob at the same target from that ally's location.

Upgrade (Level 12): The shadowy blob will now explode before disappearing. Enemies hit by the explosion are affected as if they were hit by the shadowy blob itself.
hoopa.confusion: Unleash a telekinetic force in the designated direction, dealing damage to the first enemy hit. The telekinetic force clings to that enemy and then causes a delayed explosion. The explosion deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
hoopa.hyperspace hole:
Hoopa creates a large ring at the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. After a set amount of time, Hoopa and any allies in the area of effect will return to their base, and their movement speed will be increased for a short time. These allies can also warp back to where the ring was created. An intact ally forward goal zone can also be designated as the location where the ring is created. Creating the ring on this forward goal zone of the top path will also create a ring on the forward goal zone of the bottom path, and vice versa. All allies, including Hoopa, can use these rings to warp between the two goal zones, and their movement speed will be increased for a short time after warping. After an ally warps, there is a set cooldown before that ally can use these rings again. If a path's forward goal zone is destroyed, the middle goal zone on the same path will take its place. This move cannot be used on base goal zones.

Upgrade (Level 10): Also increases the movement speed of allies near the ring when they are heading towards it.
hoopa.trick:
Hoopa creates a link between itself and an ally using a ring, increasing both of their movement speeds and granting them each a shield for a short time. When Hoopa uses Shadow Ball or performs a basic attack, the ring on the linked ally also unleashes the same move or attack. Hoopa can also use this move on themself, increasing movement speed and granting a shield for a short time. Additionally, it increases the damage dealt by Shadow Ball.

Upgrade (Level 10): Also restores the linked ally Pokémon's HP when it deals damage to enemies.
hoopa.rings unbound: Transforms Hoopa into Hoopa Unbound for a short time, increasing max HP and creating a ring at the designated location. Each ally can warp to the ring's location one time. As Hoopa Unbound, moves change to Hyperspace Fury and Psybeam. Hoopa Unbound cannot score goals or activate the Magician ability.
hoopa.magician: In battles where the map is divided into an ally team side and an opposing team side, this ability creates a hole under one of the berries on the opposing team's side (chosen at random) and warps it in front of Hoopa. If there are no berries, but there is Aeos Energy on the ground, then some energy is warped in front of Hoopa instead. In the event that no berries from the opposing team's side are warped, the cooldown of this ability is reduced.

lucario.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, performing a combo attack with a bone. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.
lucario.quick attack: Has the user lunge forward at a speed that makes it almost invisible, dealing damage to enemies it comes in contact with.
lucario.extreme speed:
Charge forward with breathtaking speed. If this move hits an enemy from point-blank range, its cooldown is reset and it restores the user's HP. However, the cooldown cannot be continually reset by using this move on the same enemy multiple times in succession.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases Attack for a short time when this move is used.
lucario.power-up punch:
Charges power before unleashing a powerful attack. While the user is charging power, its movement speed is decreased but its Attack slowly increases and the damage it receives is reduced. The user then charges in the designated direction and releases this move, dealing more damage the lower the enemies remaining HP is. The next basic attack becomes a boosted attack if the move hits. This move's cooldown is reduced every time one of the user's moves hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Become immune to hindrances while charging power.
lucario.meteor mash: Blast forward with a punch like a comet, dealing damage to enemies and shoving them.
lucario.bone rush:
Performs a combo attack with a bone, dealing multiple damaging blows to enemies and shoving them. The final attack sends the bone flying. If used again while the bone is traveling, the user rushes to the location of the bone, dealing damage to nearby enemies.

Upgrade (Level 13): Using this move again will reset the cooldown for Extreme Speed or Power-Up Punch.
lucario.close combat:
Unleash a combo attack, dealing multiple blows to enemies and shoving them.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
lucario.aura cannon: Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Increases the damage dealt by the user's next Power-Up Punch after using this move.
lucario.steadfast: While at low HP, gain a shield and increased movement speed. (30s cooldown).

machamp.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage when it hits. This boosted attack also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.
machamp.karate chop: Attack opposing Pokémon with a sharp chop.
machamp.close combat:
Unleash a series of punches in the designated direction, dealing increased damage with the last punch. The user can move while using this move and becomes immune to hindrances.

Upgrade (Level 13): Deals increased damage to enemies that are afflicted by a status condition.
machamp.cross chop:
Has the user deliver a double chop with forearms crossed while dashing forward. This increases the user's critical-hit rate.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases Attack with each basic attack, up to a set max.
machamp.bulk up: Become immune to hindrances for a short time. Increases movement speed, basic attack speed, and Attack. The next basic attack also becomes a boosted attack.
machamp.dynamic punch:
Jump to the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act when it hits. After using this move, the user becomes immune to hindrances, their movement speed and basic attack speed is increased. The next basic attack also becomes a boosted attack.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased Attack and movement speed.
machamp.submission:
Increases movement speed and become immune to hindrances. When the next basic attack hits, the attack deals increased damage and slams the enemy onto the ground, leaving it unable to act. Once this move ends, the user's critical-hit rate and basic attack speed are increased for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased critical-hit rate and basic attack speed.
machamp.barrage blow: Increases Machamp's movement speed by 5%, Attack by 30%, Defense by 200, and Sp. Defense by 200 for 10s. If used again, unleash a combo attack, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and shoving them. The final blow deals double the damage of the previous hits.
machamp.guts: Increases Attack when afflicted by a status condition.

mamoswine.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage and freezing enemies for a short time when it hits. Mamoswine's basic attacks deal increased damage for a short time to enemies recently frozen with one of Mamoswine's moves.
mamoswine.ice shard: Hurls 3 chunks of ice at the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If an enemy is hit by all three chunks, they're left frozen for a short time.
mamoswine.icicle crash:
Drops icicles on the designated location, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. The final icicle shatters after a set amount of time or when hit by Mamoswine's other moves or boosted attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them frozen. If the icicle is shattered by Tackle or High Horsepower, the ground is covered in ice, which increases the movement speed of allies that run over it. The next basic attack is boosted.

Upgrade (Level 11): The final icicle leaves enemies hit unable to act for a short time.
mamoswine.ice fang:
Uses cold-infused fangs to throw the opposing Pokémon closest to the user, dealing damage and leaving them frozen for a short time. The user can then designate a direction to slam the thrown Pokémon forward or backward, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them frozen for a short time. The next basic attack is boosted.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the area of effect in which enemies are left frozen after the slam attack.
mamoswine.tackle: Mamoswine rushes recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies they hit and throws them in the air.
mamoswine.high horsepower:
Mamoswine rushes recklessly in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies they hit and shove them. Mamoswine then stomps their feet, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaves them unable to act for a short time. This stomping deals increased damage to frozen enemies.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the reckless rush's speed and the length of time enemies are left unable to act.
mamoswine.earthquake:
Mamoswine leaps up in the designated direction and lands forcefully, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and pulling them toward Mamoswine.

Upgrade (Level 13): Decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits and increases the move's pulling power.
mamoswine.mammoth mash: Mamoswine jumps to the designated location and becomes immune to hindrances - then repeatedly stomps the ground, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time with each stomp. The final stomp throws enemies in the air.
mamoswine.thick fat: When Mamoswine deals damage, Defense and Sp. Def are increased for 3s, stacking up to 3 times. When Mamoswine uses Ice Shard, Icicle Crash or Ice Fang, the next basic attack is boosted. If any of these moves creates a freezing area of effect inside an ally goal zone, the goal-scoring speed of enemies is decreased.

mr-mime.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and throwing enemies when it hits.
mr-mime.fake out: Slap its hands together, shoving enemies in front of it.
mr-mime.confusion:
Attacks straight in front of the user, dealing damage to enemies and shoving them. If an enemy shoved by this move hits an obstacle, it receives increased damage from this move and is left unable to act for a short time. If the enemy is currently guard-swapped, it is not shoved but receives increased damage from this move and is left unable to act for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
mr-mime.psychic:
Centers one telekinetic blast each on the user, any guard-swapped enemies, and any Light Screen or Barrier walls created by the user, damaging all enemies caught in the blasts and lowering their Sp. Defense for a short time. If an enemy is hit by multiple overlapping blasts, that enemy is also left unable to act for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time.
mr-mime.light screen: Create a wall of light in the designated area that prevents enemies from passing.
mr-mime.barrier:
Create a translucent wall in the designated location that prevents enemies from passing. A maximum of two uses can be kept in reserve for this move and cannot be used more than once every 2s.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the max number of uses that can be kept in reserve.
mr-mime.power swap:
Swaps the user's Defense and Sp. Defense stats with those of another Pokémon for a short time when it hits. Swapping with an enemy deals damage over time and decreases their movement speed while increasing the user's movement speed for a short time. Swapping with an ally increases the movement speed of that ally and the user for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also continually restores the HP of the user and the ally while this move is in effect.
mr-mime.showtime: Jump to the designated location and start a pantomime performance, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act for a short time.
mr-mime.filter: Reduced damage received for a short time after using a move.

ninetales.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
ninetales.powder snow: Attack with a chilly gust of powdery snow, decreasing the movement speed of enemies for a short time when it hits.
ninetales.avalanche:
Attack with a gush of chilly ice toward the designated area. The ice forms a wall that cannot be passed through on land. After a short time this wall melts and collapses, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
ninetales.dazzling gleam:
Attack with a powerful cone of blinding light, leaving enemies unable to act when this move hits.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage dealt and stun duration.
ninetales.icy wind: Attack with a gust of freezing air, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time when it hits.
ninetales.blizzard:
Summons a howling blizzard in two blasts in front of the user. The first blast deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreases their movement speed for a short time. The second blast deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and shoves them. If the second blast hits an obstacle, it also deals damage to enemies near the point of impact.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
ninetales.aurora veil:
Create an aurora around the user, reducing damage received by the user and nearby allies in the area of effect. While the user is inside the aurora, its movement speed is increased and its basic attacks become boosted attacks.

Upgrade (Level 13): Further reduces damage allies receive.
ninetales.snow globe: Attacks with a chilly blast of snow and ice, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect when it hits. Deals increased damage to enemies that are frozen.
ninetales.snow warning: Causes snow to fall on an enemy, dealing damage to it and decreasing their movement speed by 30% for .75s. Boosted attacks, Snow Warning, and all moves (except Aurora Veil) sling snow; hitting the same target with snow 4 times will freeze them for 1s. This ability has an 8s cooldown.

palkia.attack: After a set amount of time passes, the next basic attack changes depending on its target. If the target is a wild Pokémon, the basic attack deals increased damage. If the target is a Pokémon from the opposing team, the basic attack becomes a boosted attack, dealing damage to the Pokémon it hits and leaving them unable to act.
palkia.aqua ring: Has the user summon a ring of water around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect, then continually restoring the user's HP for a short time.
palkia.aura sphere:
Has the user let loose a pulse of aura power in the designated direction, dealing damage and marking opposing Pokémon it hits. When the user attacks marked opposing Pokémon, the mark is consumed, dealing additional damage. Consuming a mark restores the user's HP once.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also applies a slowing effect when it hits.
palkia.slash: Has the user dash in the designated direction and slash with its claws, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits.
palkia.dragon claw:
Has the user bend space to teleport to the designated location before slashing with its sharp claws when it reappears, dealing damage. This move can then be used again. This move's follow-up attack has the user slash forward, dealing damage. The lower the opposing Pokémon's remaining HP, the more damage the attack deals.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases Defense and Sp. Def based on the number of Pokémon hit by this move's initial attack (up to 3 Pokémon).
palkia.multi dimensional rend: Has the user disappear into a spacial rift. When this move is used again, the user reappears in the designated area to unleash 3 multilayered slashes that slice up opposing Pokémon and space itself, dealing damage. The more times the user deals damage to opposing Pokémon before using this Unite Move, the more slashes it unleashes, up to a maximum of 7. If the maximum number of slashes are unleashed, all of the user's other move cooldowns are reset.
palkia.pressure: Whenever one of the Pokémon's moves hits opposing Pokémon, pressure increases (up to 3 times maximum). The Pokémon's next basic attack consumes all built-up pressure, dealing additional damage to opposing Pokémon and restoring its own HP.

pikachu.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also paralyzes enemies for a short time when it hits.
pikachu.thunder shock: Release electricity, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also paralyzes enemies for a short time.
pikachu.electro ball:
Hurl an electric orb, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them paralyzed for a short time. This move's damage increases the lower the enemies remaining HP is.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
pikachu.thunder:
Drop wicked thunderbolts, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the number of times this move attacks.
pikachu.electroweb: Attacks and captures enemies using an electric net, leaving them unable to move.
pikachu.volt tackle:
Has the user electrify itself and charge ahead, throwing opposing Pokémon.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduced cooldown.
pikachu.thunderbolt:
Attack with a strong electric blast, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and leaving them unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased damage.
pikachu.thunderstorm: Attacks enemies near the user with tremendous bolts of lightning.
pikachu.static: Paralyzes all enemies nearby for a short time when receiving damage. This ability goes on cooldown after it's triggered.

sableye.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If Sableye is in stealth when it hits an opposing Pokémon with a boosted attack, it will deal damage and apply a fear effect. Opposing Pokémon affected by fear will be forced to move away from Sableye. When the user enters stealth, it will charge boosted attack immediately and hold it.
sableye.thief: Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to any Pokémon it hits and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If this move hits an enemy Pokémon, it steals a small amount of their Aeos energy. If those Pokémon do not have any Aeos energy, they will be left unable to act for a short time.
sableye.knock off:
Dashes in the designated direction and then back again while attacking around itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon hit by the attacks and leaving them unable to act for a short time. For a short time afterward, this move can be used again. If it is, the user attacks in front of itself with its claws, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits and throwing them. When either the first or second stage of this move hits opposing Pokémon, those Pokémon will drop some of their collected Aeos energy, and for a short time, they’ll be unable to pick up Aeos energy. When either stage of this move hits opposing Pokémon that do not have Aeos energy, those Pokémon will be left unable to act—and for a longer duration. While using this move, the user receives reduced damage.

Upgrade (Level 10): For a short time after this move is used, the next time the user picks up Aeos energy, the user recovers HP and has its movement speed increased.
sableye.shadow sneak:
For a short time, increases the user’s movement speed and has it enter stealth. While this move is active, the user’s next boosted basic attack deals additional damage. While this move is active, if the user exits stealth and is not immobilized by a hindrance, it will be able to enter stealth again.

Upgrade (Level 10): Increases the duration of this move’s effects. While this move is active and the user is in stealth, it will also gradually recover HP.
sableye.astonish: Attacks in a cone in front of itself, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and decreasing their movement speed for a short time. If this move hits opposing Pokémon from behind, it deals increased damage and applies a greater decrease in movement speed.
sableye.feint attack:
Has the user throw dummy Aeos energy to a designated location. While dummy Aeos energy remains at a location, that location and the area around it will be visible to the user. Dummy Aeos energy can remain at up to five locations at a time. If an opposing Pokémon picks up dummy Aeos energy, that energy explodes, dealing damage over time to that Pokémon and decreasing its movement speed for a short time. A maximum of three uses can be kept in reserve for this move.

Upgrade (Level 12): If an opposing Pokémon is knocked out while taking damage over time from this move, it will drop more Aeos energy than it normally would.
sableye.confuse ray:
Fires a sinister ray in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon it hits. If this move hits Pokémon from the opposing team, it also leaves them confused. While confused, Pokémon are left unable to act and start continuously attacking nearby Pokémon with basic attacks. Confused Pokémon will target nearby Pokémon in the following order of priority: first, their ally Pokémon; then, wild Pokémon; last, Pokémon on Sableye's team.

Upgrade (Level 12): Also increases the movement speed and basic attack speed of Pokémon from the opposing team while this move has left them confused.
sableye.chaos glower: Shoot light from both eyes, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in an cone in front of itself. Pokémon from the opposing team hit by this move who are facing the user are left unable to act and start preparing to return to base. If they take damage before returning to base, the return effect is cancelled, and they are left unable to act for a short time. Opposing Pokémon hit by this move who are not facing the user have their movement speed decreased for a short time.
sableye.prankster: When Sableye is outside the visual range of Pokémon from the opposing team, it enters stealth and its movement speed increases. When Sableye enters the visual range of a Pokémon from the opposing team, it does not immediately become visible but instead remains in stealth for a short time. This stealth lasts longer when approaching enemy Pokémon from behind. The Pokémon with this Ability exits stealth when it attacks.

slowbro.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, deal damage to nearby opposing Pokémon and decrease their movement speed.
slowbro.water gun: Slowbro channels a fierce stream of water which deals damage and lowers movement speed. Increase the area of effect and damage the longer this move is channeled.
slowbro.scald:
Deal damage to opposing Pokémon and create steam when it hits. Opposing Pokémon inside the steam's area are left burned and have their movement speed decreased.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased area of effect.
slowbro.surf:
Charge forward on a wave, dealing damage in an area and knock opponents back. This is followed by two more waves that deal damage and decrease enemy movement speed.

Upgrade (Level 11): The second and third waves become larger and also knock enemies back like the first wave.
slowbro.slack off: Lay down and take a rest, continuously regaining health. Damage taken will reduce the recovery effect.
slowbro.amnesia:
Nullify some damage before it takes effect. For a short time after using this move, become immune to hindrances and gain increased defense. Also increase the damage dealt by the next use of Scald or Surf.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases Sp. Attack.
slowbro.telekinesis:
Make opposing Pokémon float with psychic power. If used again, pull the opposing Pokémon toward the user.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased range and firing speed.
slowbro.slowbeam: Stare at an enemy and attack continually, dealing damage and rooting them. Grants a shield and makes the user immune to hindrances while using this move.
slowbro.oblivious: When Slowbro receives damage, the HP loss is gradual. When damaging an opponent with a move, restore some of the remaining gradual HP loss and decrease the target's Sp. Defense.

solgaleo.full metal body: This Pokémon's Attack does not decrease when affected by opposing Pokémon's moves and Abilities.
solgaleo.teleport:
Has the user instantly teleport to the designated location.

The user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
solgaleo.iron head:
Has the user charge in the designated direction, dealing damage and shoving opposing Pokémon with its steel-hard head. If this move is used again, the user leaps toward opposing Pokémon in front of itself, leaving them unable to act and dealing damage multiple times while restoring the user's HP.

Upgrade (Level 9): Increases the duration opposing Pokémon are left unable to act.
solgaleo.cosmic power: Has the user absorb mystical power from space, increasing Defense and Sp. Def for a short time. The user's next basic attack also becomes a boosted attack.
solgaleo.psyshock:
Has the user charge power, then attack by materializing a mysterious psychic wave, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon and throwing them.

While the user charges power, its movement speed is increased, damage received is reduced, and it initially becomes resistant to hindrances for a short time.

When the psychic wave hits opposing Pokémon, the user can perform a follow-up attack.

The follow-up attack has the user slash in front of itself with sharp claws, dealing damage and applying a slowing effect to opposing Pokémon in the area of effect and restoring the user's HP.

When this follow-up attack hits Pokémon from the opposing team, it can be used again once.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases the amount of HP restored by this move.
solgaleo.shining meteor crush:
Has the user unleash immense power and enter Radiant Sun phase, then jump up high and charge toward the designated Pokémon from the opposing team, dealing damage and ignoring the Defense and shield of opposing Pokémon in the area of effect.

While in Radiant Sun phase, the user is able to see nearby Pokémon that are in stealth or hiding in tall grass. The user's moves, basic attacks, and boosted attacks also ignore opposing Pokémon's Defense and shield.

When nearby ally Pokémon get knocked out, the Unite Move gauge charges.
solgaleo.attack - cosmog: Cosmog shoots an orb of energy. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack.
solgaleo.unaware: Reduces physical and special type damage by 30%. True type damage will bypass this.

snorlax.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack. When this boosted attack hits, it deals damage to nearby enemies and decreases their movement speed for a short time.
snorlax.tackle: Charge forward belly first, dealing damage when it hits and shoving the first enemy it comes in contact with. After this move, the user's next basic attack becomes a boosted attack.
snorlax.heavy slam:
Has the user slam its heavy body down, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throwing them.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
snorlax.flail:
Has the user flail about, increasing the user's basic attack damage the lower the user's HP is.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage. If the user has low HP while using this move, its basic attacks that hit enemies will restore the user's HP.
snorlax.rest: Has the user fall asleep on the spot and restores its HP. Blocks the movement of all enemies while this move is in effect.
snorlax.block:
Has the user spread its arms wide to create a wall and grants it a shield. Prevents enemies from passing through the wall and shoves them if they run into it.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduces the damage the user receives while this move is in effect.
snorlax.yawn:
Has the user let loose a huge yawn that lulls enemies into a sleepy haze, putting enemies hit by this move to sleep.

Upgrade (Level 13): Decrease the movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
snorlax.power nap: Go to sleep and begin snoring, dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. While sleeping, become immune to hindrances and continually restore HP.
snorlax.gluttony: Increases the effects gained from eating Berries.

talonflame.attack: Becomes a boosted attack every third attack, creating a fiery whirlwind that deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. This boosted attack remains readied even after leaving combat for a prolonged period of time.
talonflame.peck: Fly toward an enemy and attack 3 times.
talonflame.flame charge:
Fly in the designated direction while cloaked in flame, attacking enemies in the path. This also increases the movement speed for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): For a short time after this move hits, Talonflame's abilities and basic attacks partially ignore the enemies defense.
talonflame.aerial ace:
Fly at the designated enemy, dealing damage. Also makes the next basic attack a boosted attack.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage.
talonflame.acrobatics: Fly toward the designated area and attack multiple times. Escape in a direction of your choice after using this move.
talonflame.fly:
Fly up into the sky. Using this move again will cause you to dive to the designated area and attack, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Your next basic attack becomes a boosted attack. This move's cooldown is reduced by 40% if it hits an enemy.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also throws enemies when this move hits.
talonflame.brave bird:
Dive to the designated location while cloaked in flame, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect. Also deals recoil damage to the user when it hits. Performing a boosted attack within a set amount of time after this move hits will reset the cooldown of Flame Charge or Aerial Ace.

Upgrade (Level 13): Deals less recoil damage when this move hits.
talonflame.flame sweep: Perform an aerial somersault before charging forward, dealing damage to enemies in this move's path and shoving them.
talonflame.gale wings: While at high HP, movement speed is increased.

tsareena.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, lunging at an opposing Pokémon, damage nearby opposing Pokémon and lowering the Defense of those hit by 20% for 1s.
tsareena.razor leaf: Pelts leaves in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit. The critical-hit rate of this move is higher than that of basic attacks.
tsareena.triple axel:
Tsareena spin-kicks 3 times in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. The damage dealt increases each time a kick hits, and basic attack speed is increased for a short time after this move ends by an amount based on the number of landed kicks. Queenly Majesty Effect: Restores HP each time a kick hits.

Upgrade (Level 10): Increased damage.
tsareena.stomp:
Tsareena jumps up high and attacks enemies their feet. When this move hits, deal damage to enemies and leave them unable to act for a short time. Queenly Majesty effect: Restores HP when this move hits.

Upgrade (Level 10): Increased damage.
tsareena.rapid spin: Tsareena spins in the designated direction, dealing damage to any enemy hit. When this move hits, increase Tsareena's movement speed for a short time.
tsareena.trop kick:
Perform a flying kick in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decrease their Attack for a short time. Enemies that make contact with the flying kick's wake receive damage and have their movement speed decreased for a short time. Queenly Majesty effect: Grants Tsareena a shield when this move is used.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increased damage.
tsareena.grassy glide:
Tsareena slides in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and decreases their movement speed for a short time. This is followed by an attack in the opposite direction, dealing damage and shoving enemies hit. Queenly Majesty effect: Grants Tsareena a shield when this move is used.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increased damage.
tsareena.queen ascendant: Tsareena leaps toward an enemy from the opposing team and kicks it high into the air before showering it with a series of kicks while airborne, dealing damage to them. The moment Tsareena lands on the ground, recover HP. While airborne, the enemy that is being kicked and Tsareena are not affected by other moves.
tsareena.oblivious: When a hindrance is inflicted on Bounsweet, Steenee; decrease the duration of the effect.

venusaur.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage. This boosted attack also pulls enemies inward between the vines.
venusaur.seed bomb: Hurl a large seed at the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
venusaur.sludge bomb:
Hurl unsanitary sludge to the designated area, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect, leaving them poisoned and decreasing their movement speed and Sp. Defense for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased area of effect.
venusaur.giga drain:
Drain HP from enemies in the area of effect, dealing damage to them and restoring HP when this hits. Also reduces damage received for a short time.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increases amount of HP restored.
venusaur.razor leaf: Launch many sharp-edged leaves in a quick succession of attacks, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect.
venusaur.solar beam:
Blast a bundled beam of light, dealing damage to enemies in a line.

Upgrade (Level 13): Reduced cooldown.
venusaur.petal dance:
Scatter petals around the user, increasing movement speed for a short time and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area of effect.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increased area of effect.
venusaur.verdant anger: Launches a giant seed toward the designated area. The seed then splits apart, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and decreasing their movement speed for a short time.
venusaur.overgrow: When HP is low, increases all damage dealt.

wigglytuff.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing damage to enemies and spinning them around when it hits.
wigglytuff.pound: Perform a combo attack in front, dealing damage to enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when the attack hits.
wigglytuff.double slap:
Perform a combo attack in front, dealing damage to enemies and decreasing their movement speed for a short time when the attack hits.

Upgrade (Level 10): Increased number of attacks.
wigglytuff.dazzling gleam:
Emit a powerful flash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect twice.

Upgrade (Level 10): Also decreases the movement speed of enemies for a short time when the first hit of this move deals damage to them.
wigglytuff.defense curl: Perform a quick roll, granting the user a shield and throwing any enemies hit by the roll. Hitting an obstacle while rolling will change the direction the user is moving and reset the cooldown of Pound, Double Slap, or Dazzling Gleam.
wigglytuff.rollout:
Perform a quick roll, granting the user a shield. Also deals damage to enemies hit by the roll and throws them. Hitting an obstacle while rolling will change the direction the user is moving and reset the cooldown of Pound, Double Slap, or Dazzling Gleam.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases the length of time enemies are thrown.
wigglytuff.sing:
Wigglytuff begins singing, slowing enemies around them by 15% for 2s per "Note" and increasing Wigglytuff's movement speed by 30% for 2.5s. Enemies that stay inside the song's effect will be put to sleep (when reaching 4 Notes) for 1.5s, and have their Defense and Special Defense reduced by 25% for 1.5s.

Upgrade (Level 12): Increases the amount of time enemies are asleep to 1.75s and the duration of Defense and Sp. Defense reduction to 1.75s.
wigglytuff.starlight recital: Begin performing a recital, granting the user and nearby allies a shield as well as removing all status conditions from the affected allies and make them immune to hindrances for a short time.
wigglytuff.cute charm: When hit by an enemies attack at close range, make that enemy infatuated for a short time. Infatuated enemies become enthralled and approach Wigglytuff against their will. The effects of this ability have a cooldown and cannot trigger on the same enemy in quick succession.

zeraora.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage and paralyzing the enemy while restoring some of Zeraora's HP.
zeraora.agility: Perform a quick dash and increase basic attack speed for a short time afterward.
zeraora.volt switch:
Perform a high-speed dash, dealing damage to enemies hit and increase basic attack speed for a short time. Using this move again within a set period of time will allow the user to immediately dash back to the original position.

Upgrade (Level 11): Increased damage and basic attack speed buff duration.
zeraora.spark:
Leap at an enemy dealing damage to them. If using your basic attack before reaching the targeted enemy, instead leap at the closest enemy and deal damage to it. This move can be used 3 times before going on cooldown.

Upgrade (Level 11): Also restore HP if performing a basic attack before reaching the targeted enemy.
zeraora.slash: Pounce at an enemy and attack with sharp claws. This move's final attack throws enemies.
zeraora.discharge:
Release an electrical discharge, dealing damage to nearby enemies and grant the user a shield when it hits. If this move hits enemies that are paralyzed, it pulls them in toward the user once the move ends, dealing damage to them once again and leaving them unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): Decreases movement speed of enemies for a short time when this move hits.
zeraora.wild charge:
Charge in the designated direction. If this move hits an enemy, unleash a combo attack that also deals a set amount of damage to itself. If the user hit an enemy with Volt Switch, Spark, or a boosted attack before using this move, the number of attacks in the combo is increased.

Upgrade (Level 13): Also deals damage to nearby enemies when this hits.
zeraora.plasma gale: Unleash a blast of lightning, dealing damage to enemies in the area of effect and throw them. This also creates a zone of plasma that increases the user's basic attack range and damage dealt while inside this zone.
zeraora.volt absorb: Gain an electric charge when receiving damage, converting a portion of that damage into additional Attack.

zoroark.attack: Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, dealing increased damage.
zoroark.slash: Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit.
zoroark.shadow claw:
Dash in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies hit and leaving them unable to act for a short time. If this move hits an enemy near the end point of the dash, they will be thrown instead of being left unable to act.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the length of time enemies are thrown.
zoroark.cut:
Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies, and restoring the Zoroark's HP.

Upgrade (Level 13): Increases the amount of HP this move restores.
zoroark.fury swipes: Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies. If this move hits an enemy, for a short time afterwards, this move can be activated again.
zoroark.night slash:
For a short time, change the user’s normal movement to dash attacks. After performing a dash attack, the user’s next auto attack changes to a special auto attack. During this move’s effect duration, whenever Zoroark hits an enemy with other moves or special auto attacks, this move’s effect duration increases and the user is able to use Night Slash again. This move’s effect duration ends if the user moves when it’s unable to use Night Slash. During this move’s effect duration, if Zoroark hits enemies with a total of six moves and/or special auto attacks, Zoroark will jump into the air and then while landing, slash a set area-of-effect, dealing damage to enemies. Zoroark recovers HP if they hit enemies with this slashing attack. While jumping, the user is able to use Shadow Claw or Cut to move a set distance.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.
zoroark.feint attack:
Dashes in the designated direction, dealing damage to enemies and reducing all of the user’s move cooldowns. If this move hits an enemy, for a short time, the location where the dash started is marked, and the user is able to use this move again; returning to the marked location and dealing damage to enemies. A new mark is left where the dash started. As long as there is a mark, if the user uses another move, the mark will move to where the move was used. If the user hits enemies four times with either Feint Attack or other moves without interrupting the chain of marking, the next use of Feint Attack changes. If this changed form of Feint Attack is used, Zoroark leaps at the designated enemy and deals damage to them before landing in the designated direction.

Upgrade (Level 11): Reduces this move's cooldown by 1s.
zoroark.nightfall daze: Release dark shockwaves, dealing damage to enemies hit. Three shockwaves are released, and each one has an increasingly larger area-of-effect. Zoroark is immune to hindrances while releasing shockwaves.
zoroark.illusion: The user takes the form of a random wild Pokémon or Pokémon from the opposing team. The user returns to their original form when taking damage or using an auto attack or move (15s cd).
